**Position:** HR Recruiter Intern  
**Duration:** 6 Months Internship  
**Location:** Mala, Thrissur, Kerala  
**Company:** Sweero Delights Global Pvt. Ltd.

**About the Role**

Sweero Delights Global Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a motivated and enthusiastic HR Recruiter Intern to support our recruitment and talent acquisition activities. This internship provides practical exposure to the complete recruitment cycle and offers an excellent opportunity to build a career in Human Resources.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Assist in end\-to\-end recruitment activities including sourcing, screening, and scheduling interviews.
* Post job openings on job portals, social media platforms, and other recruitment channels.
* Source and shortlist candidates based on job requirements.
* Conduct initial candidate screening and coordinate interviews with hiring managers.
* Maintain and update candidate databases and recruitment trackers.
* Support onboarding activities and employee documentation.
* Coordinate with candidates regarding interview schedules, joining formalities, and follow\-ups.
* Assist the HR team in various administrative and employee engagement activities.

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Graduates, MBA (HR) students, or candidates with HR\-related certifications.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Good interpersonal and organizational abilities.
* Basic knowledge of MS Office and online recruitment platforms.
* Willingness to learn and build a career in Human Resources.
* Candidates residing in or willing to commute to Thrissur are preferred.

**What We Offer**

* Hands\-on experience in recruitment and HR operations.
* Mentorship and practical learning in a growing organization.
* Exposure to real\-world hiring processes and talent management.
* Internship Certificate upon successful completion.
* Opportunity for full\-time employment based on performance.

**Working Hours:** Monday to Saturday, 9:30 AM to 5:30 PM  
**Internship Duration:** 6 Months (Full\-Time)

Pay: ₹5,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

title: Associate Director-Consulting Lead
description:
**Job Description**  

At NielsenIQ we autonomously contribute to analysis that resolves specific Customer concerns.


This role serves as a bridge between the Commercial team, Quality Assurance, Operations, Engineering, \& Data Science teams with regards to Customer requirements on business and insights. It also seeks to provide a strategic analysis that enables business decision making of our customers.


This role will enable customers to realize value potential of NIQ products and services. It will help our customers to get strategic insights and participate in customer business reviews. This role ensures alignment within teams at NIQ to develop a deep understanding of customer’s business objectives and work with Sales account managers to create a joint business plan. Helps in setting priorities for NIQ to contribute to customer success function. This role entails planning along with the team for delivery of services to manufacturers \& retailers using core NIQ products and services in retail measurement, E\-commerce, and Analytics. It also helps Sales team to identify whitespace opportunity, facilitate building up of the proposal thereby enhance awareness of revenue outlook based on NIQ\-Customer engagement.

  

**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**


Responsible for the day\-to\-day management of the customer, building customer engagement, focused on value creation.


Key activities include defining service model and deliverables during proposal development, delivering ongoing insights with quantifiable outcome for the customers, and identifying opportunities.


The performance metrics for success of this role will be improvement in NPS Score.

**Lead Customer Engagement**

* Develops foundational relationship with key customers and stakeholders
* Gather understanding and expertise on customer business priorities and how that ties up to consumption of NIQ products \& services
* Helps in identifying customer needs and creates a shared plan with Sales team to deliver outcomes in collaboration with NIQ internal teams
* Lead Customer engagement with thoughtful insights to help customers take useful business decisions through NIQ products and services
* Advisor and thought leader to facilitate customer solution\-related queries through persuasive, informed and consistent approach
* Become a liaison and facilitator for resolving active data queries by engaging the right global/local teams

 **Opportunity \& Pursuit Management**

* Plan a portfolio of work such as adoption of new NIQ products and services, support programs and projects, and value realization in alignment with customer business objectives
* Capture, communicate and brings forward recommendation from customer insights team and collaborate with internal teams to help identify growth opportunity through account planning and supporting delivery execution
* Work closely with Sales Account managers to maintain a stronger pipeline of opportunities through a pre\-qualified opportunity tracking: Sales Account Managers

 **Consumption \& Delivery Execution**


Record and measure product adoption rate for a pre\-assigned list of customers and strategize windows of opportunity with the Sales team


Identify opportunities, questions and issues shared by customers and propose solutions to address these issues in a decided timeframe


Work with internal teams using functional knowledge to spot the right team members to support delivery to customers


Delivery orchestration by driving solution and operational health for complex customer accounts

  

**WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?**


Interested in customer facing consulting or portfolio management? If yes, this is the right role for you. NIQ Customer Success team provides an opportunity for Program technology/business professional with experience in program governance, practice management and solution delivery.


Individuals with prior experience in solving retail (traditional/ modern trade and E\-commerce) specific solutions around sales analytics, demand management, merchandizing, brand health, salesforce activation and retail measurement. Expertise in specific product category or distribution channel will be an added advantage. With acumen to work in a matrix organization that leverages leadership and influencing skills.  



**QUALIFICATIONS**

* MBA (desirable) with 10\-15 years’ experience in FMCG / Service / Retail industry
* Strong Customer Focus and Proactiveness
* Very Good Influencing, Persuading and Project Management Skills
* Ability to connect and link insights to customers business
* Strong presentation skills, Logical thinking, Strong command on excel
* Effective writing skills

**PREFERRED SKILLSETS**

**MUST HAVE**

* Excellent oral and written communication
* Ability to articulate thoughts and solutions and express to the customer leadership
* Problem\-solving approach and attitude
* Active listening and seeking out root cause of a business problem
* Responsive and proficient in Change Management
* Analytical and logical mindset
* Internal advocate for customer needs

**GOOD TO HAVE**

* Knowledge of Analytical tools and platforms
* Understanding of data monetization lifecycle
* RMS product and process knowledge

**About Us**


NielsenIQ is a global measurement and data analytics company that provides the most complete and trusted view available of consumers and markets worldwide. We provide consumer packaged goods manufacturers/fast\-moving consumer goods and retailers with accurate, actionable information and insights and a complete picture of the complex and changing marketplace that companies need to innovate and grow. Our approach marries proprietary NielsenIQ data with other data sources to help customers around the world understand what’s happening now, what’s happening next, and how to best act on this knowledge. We like to be in the middle of the action. That’s why you can find us at work in over 90 countries, covering more than 90% of the world’s population. For more information, visit **www.niq.com****.**


NielsenIQ is committed to hiring and retaining a diverse workforce. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action\-Employer, making decisions without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability status, age, marital status, protected veteran status or any other protected class.

 **Additional Information** **Our Benefits**

* Flexible working environment
* Volunteer time off
* LinkedIn Learning
* Employee\-Assistance\-Program (EAP)


NIQ may utilize artificial intelligence (AI) tools at various stages of the recruitment process, including résumé screening, candidate assessments, interview scheduling, job matching, communication support, and certain administrative tasks that help streamline workflows. These tools are intended to improve efficiency and support fair and consistent evaluation based on job\-related criteria. All use of AI is governed by NIQ’s principles of fairness, transparency, human oversight, and inclusion. Final hiring decisions are made exclusively by humans. **About NIQ**


NIQ is the world’s leading consumer intelligence company, delivering the most complete understanding of consumer buying behavior and revealing new pathways to growth. In 2023, NIQ combined with GfK, bringing together the two industry leaders with unparalleled global reach. With a holistic retail read and the most comprehensive consumer insights—delivered with advanced analytics through state\-of\-the\-art platforms—NIQ delivers the Full View™. NIQ is an Advent International portfolio company with operations in 100\+ markets, covering more than 90% of the world’s population.


For more information, visit NIQ.com


Want to keep up with our latest updates?


Follow us on: LinkedIn \| Instagram \| Twitter \| Facebook


**Our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion**


At NIQ, we are steadfast in our commitment to fostering an inclusive workplace that mirrors the rich diversity of the communities and markets we serve. We believe that embracing a wide range of perspectives drives innovation and excellence. All employment decisions at NIQ are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. #### **Job Purpose**


The purpose of this job is ensure achievement of business targets and enhancement of profitability of the assigned area by providing effective leadership, planning resources, identifying \& implementing sales strategies, monitoring people performance and market changes and ensuring timely operations support to ensure smooth functioning of the branches.To ensure delivery of unique consumer value proposition by ensuring enabling framework for the area sales force along with Sales Training, Product, Operations, HR \& Distribution, strategy team.

#### **Job Context \& Major Challenges**


Job Context / Job Challenges:  

  

Distribution reach will be the key to future growth acceleration for insurance companies as existing geographies get saturated and the focus shifts to new under penetrated geographies.Effective distribution reach into newer geographies, alternate distribution channels, innovative products, targeting new segments are the major challenges in this industry and will be the key drivers in the future.While companies are planning to double their agency network over the next 2 years, the overall industry life agency workforce attrition rate ranges between 50\-55% which is significantly high.Hence the key challenge to recruit qualified insurance agents, especially in the semi\-urban / rural markets and also to combat the increasing attrition rate particularly when new players are entering the market.  

  

Key Challenges for the role –  

* Creating and enticing value proposition in the distributor and consumer segment for a completely new concept and product in the market.
* Ensuring profitability and timely break\-even in a cost driven market.
* Unavailability of skilled man power (BM/BH/AM/Support) in small towns
* Short gestation time to develop people because of fast business demand.
#### **Key Result Areas**

**KRA (Accountabilities) (Max 1325 Characters)** **Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)**  


KRA1 Ensure budgeted capacitation at branches \& achieve business targets assigned for the area through \& with BM to meet the functional goals. Ensure execution of an aggressive distribution creation strategy to acquire requisite number of productive agents from a crowded market to achieve targeted market penetration  


KRA2 Drive implementation of agency initiatives aimed at improving sales productivity across the assigned branches. Ensuring sales progression of the regional sales by reviewing and Motivating team for setting higher performance standards  


KRA3 Maintain relationship with the top advisors of the branches/area to enhance motivation levels. Regularly meet the top advisors of his branches/area.  


KRA4 Ensure Training \& Development for the Sales Force in the assigned territory to enhance skill development. Identify the training need \& collaborate with the training team to ensure that the timely training of the Agency Managers  


KRA5 Track attrition and renewal to achieve business health for the area. Ensure a high percentile of premium through analysis and product mix.  


KRA6 Ensure that business is done in ethical manner and customer’s and organisation’s objectives are met. Ensure that the business activities are carried out as per the compliance \& regulatory guidelines laid by the company  


KRA7 Identify business opportunities through market intelligence \& penetrate in underdeveloped market to enhance distribution reach and profitability for the assigned territory. Enhance brand awareness in underdeveloped areas for future business  


KRA8 Maintain harmony with other departments for smooth functioning \& better productivity of the area \& organisation. Have regular meetings/discussions with training / underwriting/client services/HR/Compliance /Planning \& Finance to understand their expectations \& share requirements.  


KRA9 Team Development Ensure skill enhancement of team members through continuous on the job training.

Aditya Birla Capital Limited ("NBFC") is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). ABCL offers end\-to\-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers \- Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid \& Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products. The diverse range of lending products includes Retail Small Ticket Secured and Unsecured Loans, Unsecured Personal Loans, Unsecured Business Loans, Health \& Education Loans, Digital B2B2C and B2B2B Small Ticket Loans, Small Business Secured Loans, Loans Against Property (LAP), Lease Rental Discounting (LRD), Construction Finance (to Real Estate Developers), SME Loans, Capital Markets Loans (Loan Against Shares), Supply Chain Finance, Mid and Large Corporate Loans, and Infrastructure Finance loans. ABCL also has a Wealth Management division.

**Job Description** – Senior HR Manager

**The Dhan Mill**

**Position**: Senior HR Manager

**Department**: Human Resources

**Location:** The Dhan Mill, Chhattarpur, New Delhi

**Role Overview**

The Senior HR Manager will be responsible for leading and managing the overall Human Resources function at The Dhan Mill. The role involves overseeing recruitment, payroll, statutory compliance, employee relations, performance management, policy implementation, and ensuring a positive and productive work environment while maintaining compliance with all applicable labour laws.

**Key Responsibilities**

1\. Strategic HR Management

\* Develop and implement HR strategies aligned with organizational objectives.

\* Advise management on HR policies, workforce planning, and employee\-related matters.

\* Drive initiatives to enhance employee engagement and retention.

**2\. Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition**

\* Manage the end\-to\-end recruitment process for all levels of hiring.

\* Coordinate with department heads to understand manpower requirements.

\* Ensure timely onboarding and induction of new employees.

**3\. Payroll \& Compensation**

\* Oversee monthly payroll processing and ensure timely salary disbursement.

\* Verify attendance, overtime, leave records, and payroll inputs.

\* Administer employee benefits, reimbursements, and final settlements.

**4\. Statutory Compliance**

\* Ensure compliance with all applicable labour laws and statutory requirements.

\* Manage PF, ESI, Bonus, Gratuity, Minimum Wages, Shops \& Establishment, and other regulatory compliances.

\* Coordinate statutory audits and maintain compliance records.

\* Liaise with government authorities and external consultants as required.

**5\. Employee Relations**

\* Address employee grievances and resolve workplace conflicts effectively.

\* Conduct disciplinary proceedings and ensure adherence to company policies.

\* Promote a healthy and positive work culture.

**6\. Performance Management**

\* Design and implement performance appraisal processes.

\* Support managers in setting performance goals and conducting reviews.

\* Identify training and development needs across departments.

**7\. HR Operations \& Administration**

\* Maintain employee records and HR documentation.

\* Monitor attendance, leave management, and HRMIS data accuracy.

\* Prepare monthly HR reports and management dashboards.

\* Ensure proper implementation and communication of HR policies and procedures.

**8\. Vendor \& Contract Labour Management**

\* Coordinate with manpower agencies and service providers.

\* Monitor contract labour compliance and documentation.

\* Ensure adherence to contractual and statutory obligations by vendors.

Qualifications

\* Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.

\* MBA/PGDM in HR or equivalent qualification preferred.

Experience

\* 8–12 years of progressive experience in Human Resources, including leadership responsibilities.

\* Experience in handling payroll, labour compliances, and multi\-department HR operations is essential.

**Required Skills**

\* Strong knowledge of Indian labour laws and statutory compliances.

\* Expertise in payroll processing and compensation administration.

\* Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.

\* Strong problem\-solving and conflict\-resolution abilities.

\* Proficiency in MS Office, especially MS Excel, and HRMS systems.

\* High level of integrity and confidentiality.

\* Strong organizational and stakeholder management skills.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

\* Timely and accurate payroll processing.

\* 100% statutory compliance adherence.

\* Reduction in employee grievances and attrition.

\* Timely closure of recruitment requirements.

\* Effective implementation of HR policies and initiatives.

\* Accuracy and timeliness of HR reports and documentation.

The Dhan Mill is committed to fostering a professional, inclusive, and employee\-centric workplace. The Senior HR Manager will play a critical role in building a high\-performing workforce and ensuring operational excellence through effective people management.

title: WITEC Finance Manager
description:
**Job Description**  

It’s not just about your career or job title… It’s about who you are and the impact you will make on the world. Because whether it’s for each other or our customers, we put People First. When our people come together, we Expand the Possible and continuously look for ways to improve what we create and how we do it. If you are constantly striving to grow, you’re in good company. We are revolutionizing the way the world moves for future generations, and we want someone who is ready to move with us.

 **Who are we?**

  

Wabtec Corporation is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value\-added services for freight and transit rail as well as the mining, marine, and industrial markets. Drawing on nearly four centuries of collective experience across Wabtec, GE Transportation, and Faiveley Transport, the company has grown to become One Wabtec, with unmatched digital expertise, technological innovation, and world\-class manufacturing and services, enabling the digital\-rail\-and\-transit ecosystems.

  

Wabtec is focused on performance that drives progress and unlocks our customers’ potential by delivering innovative and lasting transportation solutions that move and improve the world. We are lifelong learners obsessed with making things better to drive exceptional results. Wabtec has approximately 27K employees in facilities throughout the world. Visit our website to learn more!

 **Role Summary/Purpose**

  

The WITEC Finance Manager role is for our Global Center of Excellence for Engineering \& IT based in India. Responsibilities include managing the monthly financial close process, budgeting, and forecasting for the center’s profitable growth and balance sheet strength. The Finance Manager will work with cross functional leadership in Engineering, IT, HR, and Sourcing to review costs pertaining to all operations including the Tech labs. This position is a member of a cross\-functional team and must be able to partner with leaders from other areas of the business including but not limited to Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, Project Management and Human Resources, to achieve the business plan and would lead the finance planning and analysis for Engineering and IT across Wabtec India sites and own the consolidation and financial partnership for all related operations.

  

**Essential Responsibilities**

* Formulating budgets, support annual operating plans (AOP) and rolling forecasts for engineering departments, including OPEX (operating expenses) and CapEx.
* Compare actual expenses against budgets (variance analysis) to identify cost drivers and performance deviations for engineering leadership.
* Monitor cost center reports to ensure engineering projects remain within budget and performing cost\-benefit analyses.
* Acting as the finance partner for engineering center leadership, providing forward\-looking analytics to assist in investment decisions, capacity planning and strategies \& realize organizational goals.
* Work on Month\-end activities, including General Ledger (GL) scrutiny, provisioning, and reviewing accruals.
* Support closure of statutory books of accounts and other audits, working with Regional Controllership team, as required.
* Support closure of tax assessment and audits, working with regional tax team, as required.

 **Qualifications / Requirements**

  

1\. Chartered Accountant with 5\+ years of post\-qualification experience in finance, accounting, preferably in a manufacturing/engineering environment  

2\. Strong information systems/ERP system experience  

3\. Ability to work and prioritize under tight deadlines  

4\. Ability to summarize and communicate effectively with cross\-functional teams and with global and regional executives  

5\. Strong interpersonal and leadership skills  



**Our Commitment to Embrace Diversity:**

  

Wabtec is a global company that invests not just in our products, but also our people by embracing diversity and inclusion. We care about our relationships with our employees and take pride in celebrating the variety of experiences, expertise, and backgrounds that bring us together. At Wabtec, we aspire to create a place where we all belong and where diversity is welcomed and appreciated.

  

To fulfill that commitment, we rely on a culture of leadership, diversity, and inclusion. We aim to employ the world’s brightest minds to help us create a limitless source of ideas and opportunities. We have created a space where everyone is given the opportunity to contribute based on their individual experiences and perspectives and recognize that these differences and diverse perspectives make us better.

  

We believe in hiring talented people of varied backgrounds, experiences, and styles… People like you! Wabtec Corporation is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or protected Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

 **Additional Information** **What could you accomplish in a place that puts People First?**


At Wabtec, it’s not just about a job \- it’s about the impact you make. When our people come together, we’re Expanding the Possible by continuously improving what we do and how we do it \- for our clients and each other.


If you’re ready to revolutionize how the world moves for future generations, Wabtec is the place for you.  



**Who are we?**


Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value\-added services for the freight and transit rail sectors. Drawing on more than 150 years of experience, we are leading the way in safety, efficiency, reliability, innovation, and productivity. Whether it’s freight, transit, ports, logistics, mining, industrial, or marine, our expertise, technologies, and people together – are accelerating the future of transportation. With roots that date back to George Westinghouse, Thomas Edison, and Louis Faiveley, Wabtec has always built technologies and implemented solutions for a variety of sectors that are critical to meeting the needs of customers and governments alike.


Our global team of about 30,000 employees worldwide delivers performance that moves the world forward. We’re lifelong learners, obsessed with better. Learn more at www.WabtecCorp.com.

**Culture powers us and the possibilities.**


We believe the best ideas come from a mix of experiences and backgrounds. At Wabtec, we strive every day to create a place where everyone belongs. We’re building a culture where leadership, inclusion and your unique perspective fuel progress.

  

We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome talent of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including race, gender, age, disability, veteran status and more.


Need accommodation? Just let us know \- we’ve got you.

description:

Mechanical Design Engineer (Fresher)

* Job Description

We are seeking a motivated and enthusiastic **Fresher Mechanical Design Engineer** to join our team, specializing in the design and development of industrial **filling and packaging machinery**. This entry\-level role is ideal for a recent graduate with a strong foundation in mechanical engineering principles, CAD software, and a passion for machine design, automation, and manufacturing processes. The successful candidate will work under the guidance of senior engineers to contribute to all phases of the product lifecycle, from concept and detailed design to testing and final implementation.

* Key Roles and Responsibilities

The primary responsibilities of the Fresher Mechanical Design Engineer will involve supporting the engineering team in various design and documentation tasks:

1\. Design and Drafting Support

* **3D Modeling and 2D Drafting:** Create and modify detailed **3D models** and **2D engineering drawings** of machine components, sub\-assemblies, and complete machine layouts using CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, AutoCAD, Inventor).
* **Component Selection:** Assist in the selection of standard mechanical components such as motors, gears, bearings, pneumatics, and fasteners, ensuring they meet design specifications and industry standards.
* **Design Documentation:** Maintain and update the engineering documentation library, including Bills of Materials (**BOMs**), assembly instructions, and technical specifications for manufacturing.

2\. Analysis and Optimization

* **Basic Calculations:** Perform fundamental engineering calculations (e.g., stress, strain, tolerance, material strength) to validate design integrity and functionality.
* **Tolerance Stacks:** Conduct **tolerance analysis** to ensure proper fit and function between mating parts, focusing on designs for manufacturability and assembly (**DFMA**).
* **Prototyping Assistance:** Support the engineering team during the prototyping and initial build phase, observing and reporting on machine performance and identifying areas for design improvement.

3\. Manufacturing and Quality Liaison

* **Supplier Interaction:** Work with procurement and external suppliers to review component specifications and ensure timely delivery of parts according to design requirements.
* **Shop Floor Support:** Act as a technical resource for the production and assembly teams, addressing design\-related queries and providing clarification on engineering drawings.
* **Quality Checks:** Participate in the inspection and testing of finished components and assemblies to confirm they adhere to the design specifications and quality standards.

4\. Continuous Improvement and Learning

* **Standards Compliance:** Learn and adhere to industry\-specific safety, hygiene, and performance standards relevant to food/beverage and pharmaceutical packaging equipment (e.g., **FDA, GMP**).
* **Problem\-Solving:** Assist senior engineers in investigating and resolving mechanical failures, performance issues, and root cause analysis during testing or field deployment.
* **Documentation:** Prepare technical reports, design review presentations, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) as required.

Qualifications

Education and Experience

* **Bachelor's degree** in Mechanical Engineering or a related field from an accredited institution.
* **Prior full\-time industry experience required** (3\-5 years of experience is acceptable, including relevant internships or academic projects).

Technical Skills

* Proficiency in at least one major **3D CAD software** (e.g., **Onshape,** SolidWorks, Inventor, CATIA).
* Strong understanding of **GD\&T** (Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing) principles.
* Solid knowledge of mechanical engineering fundamentals, including **statics, dynamics, material science**, and **machine design**.
* Familiarity with manufacturing processes such as **CNC machining, welding, sheet metal fabrication**, and various surface treatments.

Soft Skills

* Excellent **written and verbal communication** skills.
* Strong **problem\-solving** and analytical abilities with a keen attention to detail.
* Ability to **work collaboratively** in a team environment and take direction from senior staff.
* Proactive attitude and a strong desire to learn and take ownership of tasks.

This role offers an excellent opportunity to gain practical experience in the specialized field of automated machinery design. Do you want to explore the specific technical challenges unique to filling and packaging equipment, such as high\-speed mechanics or hygienic design?

title: Talent Acquisition Analyst
description:
Executive Hiring Research Assistant – Global Talent Acquisition
  
  

Our Mission
  
  

We believe that exceptional leaders shape exceptional organizations. Our Global Executive Hiring team is dedicated to finding and engaging the world’s most visionary leaders who will drive innovation, inspire teams, and create lasting impact. We operate at the intersection of strategy, research, and human connection, ensuring that every leadership hire strengthens our mission to build a better, more inclusive future.
  
  

Our work spans continents, industries, and cultures. From identifying a transformative CEO for a new market to mapping leadership talent for emerging business units, we are trusted advisors to the business on one of its most important investments—its people. We value curiosity, integrity, and a relentless pursuit of excellence, and we believe that the right leader can change the trajectory of an entire organization.
  
  

The Impact You'll Make
  
  

As an Executive Hiring Research Assistant, you will be the intelligence engine behind our global leadership recruitment efforts. Your research will help identify, map, and engage top\-tier executive talent across industries and geographies. You’ll work closely with senior recruiters, hiring leaders, and HR business partners, providing insights that shape hiring strategies for some of the most critical leadership roles in the organization.
  
  

This role is designed for campus recruitment candidates who are eager to learn the art and science of executive search. You will gain hands\-on experience in understanding global talent markets, leadership assessment, and the strategic decision\-making process behind high\-stakes hiring. Your work will directly influence how we approach leadership hiring, from building diverse talent pipelines to advising on market trends that impact our business strategy.
  
  

What You'll Do
  
* Conduct in\-depth market mapping to identify potential executive candidates across global regions, industries, and functions.
* Research target companies, leadership structures, and industry trends to support search strategies and talent intelligence reports.
* Build and maintain comprehensive talent databases, ensuring data accuracy, relevance, and compliance with privacy regulations.
* Prepare candidate briefs that summarize professional backgrounds, leadership achievements, and potential fit for specific roles.
* Develop competitive intelligence reports that highlight market shifts, competitor leadership moves, and emerging talent pools.
* Collaborate with the global executive hiring team to refine search criteria, outreach strategies, and diversity hiring approaches.
* Track and analyze recruitment metrics to identify patterns, bottlenecks, and opportunities for process improvement.
* Support special projects such as diversity and inclusion initiatives, leadership succession planning, and emerging market talent strategies.
* Participate in team meetings, brainstorming sessions, and knowledge\-sharing forums to contribute to fresh perspectives.


What You'll Bring
  
* A recent graduate or final\-year student with a strong academic record in Business, Human Resources, Economics, Psychology, International Relations, or related fields.
* Exceptional research and analytical skills—comfortable navigating LinkedIn Recruiter, industry reports, organizational charts, and other talent intelligence tools.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present findings clearly, concisely, and persuasively.
* Curiosity about leadership, organizational structures, and global business trends, with a willingness to explore unfamiliar industries.
* High attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, global environment.
* A collaborative mindset, openness to feedback, and eagerness to learn from experienced global recruiters and researchers.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and familiarity with data visualization tools is a plus.
* Cultural awareness and sensitivity when working with colleagues and candidates from diverse backgrounds.


Why You'll Love It Here
  
* Global exposure – Work on leadership searches spanning multiple countries, industries, and cultures.
* Mentorship and learning – Receive guidance from senior talent acquisition leaders with decades of executive search experience.
* Access to premium tools – Learn to use industry\-leading research platforms and databases used by top executive search firms.
* Impactful work – Contribute to hiring decisions that shape the future of our organization.
* Diversity and inclusion focus – Be part of initiatives that ensure our leadership reflects the diversity of our customers and communities.
* Professional development – Access to structured learning programs, leadership speaker series, and a dedicated annual learning stipend.
* Supportive culture – A collaborative, inclusive environment where your ideas are valued and your growth is prioritized.
* Competitive campus hire package, comprehensive health benefits, and generous paid time off.

title: EHS Officer
description:
**Job Description**

**Job Title**

EHS Officer

**Department**

EHS

**Location**

Mumbai

**Reporting To**

Manager \- EHS

**Job Summary**

The EHS Officer is responsible for implementing, monitoring, and enforcing Environment, Health \& Safety (EHS) standards across commercial interior fit\-out project sites. The role ensures compliance with company policies, client requirements, and statutory regulations while promoting a proactive safety culture. The incumbent will lead site safety inspections, risk assessments, permit\-to\-work management, incident investigations, safety training programs, and emergency preparedness initiatives to ensure safe project execution and achievement of organizational EHS objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**EHS Management \& Compliance**

* Implement and monitor EHS policies, procedures, and safety management systems across project sites.
* Ensure compliance with applicable statutory regulations, client requirements, and company safety standards.
* Conduct regular site inspections, audits, and compliance assessments.
* Monitor subcontractor safety performance and ensure adherence to project EHS requirements.
* Ensure all work activities are executed in accordance with approved safety procedures and risk control measures.

**Hazard Identification \& Risk Management**

* Conduct Hazard Identification and Risk Assessment (HIRA) for project activities.
* Review Job Safety Analysis (JSA), Method Statements, and Risk Assessments.
* Identify safety hazards and implement preventive and corrective actions.
* Monitor high\-risk activities including work at height, hot work, lifting operations, electrical work, and confined space activities.

**Permit\-to\-Work (PTW) Management**

* Administer and monitor Permit\-to\-Work systems for critical activities.
* Ensure permits are properly authorized, implemented, and closed.
* Verify compliance with permit requirements before work commencement.

**Incident Management**

* Investigate accidents, incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions.
* Conduct root cause analysis and recommend corrective and preventive actions.
* Maintain incident records and ensure timely reporting to management and clients.
* Track closure of corrective actions arising from investigations.

**Training \& Safety Awareness**

* Conduct EHS induction programs for employees, workers, subcontractors, and visitors.
* Deliver toolbox talks, safety campaigns, and awareness programs.
* Promote behavioral safety initiatives and continuous safety improvement.
* Develop safety communication materials and awareness content.

**Emergency Preparedness \& Response**

* Develop and implement emergency response plans for project sites.
* Organize emergency drills, mock exercises, and evacuation programs.
* Ensure availability and maintenance of emergency equipment, first\-aid facilities, and firefighting systems.
* Coordinate emergency response activities during incidents.

**Documentation \& Reporting**

* Maintain EHS records, registers, permits, audit reports, and compliance documentation.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly EHS performance reports.
* Monitor and report safety KPIs, observations, incidents, and compliance metrics.
* Support client audits, external inspections, and certification requirements.

**Environmental Management**

* Monitor environmental compliance related to waste management, dust control, noise management, and housekeeping.
* Promote environmentally sustainable practices across project sites.
* Ensure compliance with environmental regulations and project requirements.

**Leadership \& Coordination**

* Guide and supervise Assistant EHS Officers, EHS Supervisors, and EHS Stewards.
* Coordinate with Project Managers, Site Engineers, and subcontractors on EHS matters.
* Support achievement of project safety objectives and organizational EHS goals.
* Any other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications \& Experience**

**Education**

* Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Engineering, Science, Environmental Management, or any related discipline.
* Diploma/Advanced Diploma in Industrial Safety, Occupational Health \& Safety, Fire \& Safety, or equivalent.

**Experience**

* 4–7 years of relevant experience in EHS within Commercial Interior Fit\-Out, Construction, Infrastructure, Industrial, or Manufacturing projects.
* Strong experience in site safety management and statutory compliance.
* Experience managing subcontractor safety and permit\-to\-work systems.
* Knowledge of client EHS requirements and safety audits.

**Certifications (Preferred)**

* NEBOSH IGC.
* IOSH Managing Safely.
* OSHA Certification.
* First Aid \& CPR Certification.
* ISO 45001 Internal Auditor Certification.

**Knowledge, Skills \& Competencies**

**Technical Skills**

* Construction Safety Management.
* Hazard Identification \& Risk Assessment (HIRA).
* Permit\-to\-Work (PTW) Management.
* Incident Investigation \& Root Cause Analysis.
* Emergency Response Planning.
* Safety Audits \& Compliance Monitoring.
* Environmental Management.
* EHS Reporting \& Documentation.
* Knowledge of OSHA, NEBOSH, ISO 45001, and applicable statutory regulations.
* Strong understanding of commercial interior fit\-out construction activities.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Leadership and Supervision.
* Communication and Presentation Skills.
* Stakeholder Management.
* Problem Solving and Decision Making.
* Attention to Detail.
* Conflict Resolution.
* Team Collaboration.
* Accountability and Integrity.
* Adaptability and Results Orientation.

**Working Relationships**

**Internal Stakeholders**

* EHS Manager
* Project Managers
* Site Engineers
* Construction Supervisors
* HR Department
* Operations Team
* Procurement Team
* Project Workforce

**External Stakeholders**

* Clients and Client Safety Representatives
* Consultants
* Subcontractors
* Government Safety Authorities

**Job Summary**

The EHS Manager is responsible for leading and managing the Environment, Health \& Safety (EHS) function across multiple commercial interior fit\-out projects. The role ensures compliance with statutory regulations, client requirements, and company EHS standards while driving a proactive safety culture throughout the organization. The incumbent will oversee EHS strategy implementation, risk management, incident prevention, compliance audits, environmental management, emergency preparedness, and team development to achieve world\-class safety performance and operational excellence.

**Key Responsibilities**

**EHS Leadership \& Strategy**

* Implement the organization's EHS policies, standards, and strategic initiatives across all assigned projects.
* Support the Head \- EHS in developing and enhancing EHS management systems and programs.
* Establish safety objectives, KPIs, and performance improvement plans for projects.
* Promote a strong safety culture through leadership engagement and behavioral safety initiatives.
* Drive continuous improvement in EHS performance across the organization.

**EHS Compliance \& Governance**

* Ensure compliance with applicable health, safety, environmental, and labor regulations.
* Ensure adherence to client\-specific EHS requirements and contractual obligations.
* Monitor implementation of ISO 45001, ISO 14001, and company management systems.
* Conduct periodic compliance audits, inspections, and management reviews.
* Ensure timely closure of audit findings and corrective actions.

**Risk Management**

* Lead Hazard Identification and Risk Assessment (HIRA) processes across projects.
* Review Job Safety Analysis (JSA), Method Statements, and permit systems.
* Monitor high\-risk construction and interior fit\-out activities.
* Develop and implement risk mitigation plans to eliminate or reduce workplace hazards.

**Incident Management**

* Lead investigations of accidents, incidents, near misses, and environmental events.
* Conduct root cause analysis and ensure implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
* Monitor incident trends and develop preventive safety programs.
* Ensure statutory reporting and compliance for reportable incidents.

**Environmental Management**

* Ensure compliance with environmental regulations and sustainability requirements.
* Monitor waste management, pollution control, resource utilization, and environmental performance.
* Promote environmentally sustainable construction and fit\-out practices.
* Drive environmental awareness initiatives across project teams.

**Emergency Preparedness \& Business Continuity**

* Develop and implement emergency response and crisis management plans.
* Organize emergency drills, mock exercises, and evacuation programs.
* Ensure readiness of firefighting systems, emergency equipment, and medical response arrangements.
* Coordinate emergency response activities during incidents.

**Training \& Competency Development**

* Develop and implement EHS training programs for employees, subcontractors, and management teams.
* Conduct leadership safety workshops, induction programs, and awareness campaigns.
* Assess competency requirements and support professional development of EHS personnel.
* Foster a culture of accountability and safety ownership.

**Team Leadership \& Management**

* Lead and manage Assistant EHS Managers, EHS Officers, Supervisors, and site safety teams.
* Allocate resources and provide guidance to ensure effective EHS implementation.
* Conduct performance reviews, coaching, and mentoring of team members.
* Build a high\-performing EHS organization aligned with business objectives.

**Reporting \& Stakeholder Management**

* Prepare and present EHS performance reports, dashboards, and management reviews.
* Report EHS performance metrics to senior leadership and clients.
* Coordinate with Project Managers, Operations Heads, HR, and business leaders on EHS matters.

* Support organizational initiatives related to quality, sustainability, and operational excellence.
* Ensure EHS requirements are integrated into project planning and execution.

**Experience**

* Mandatory experience in Commercial Interior Fit\-Out, Construction, Infrastructure, or Building Projects.

**About S3V Vascular Technologies**

S3V Vascular Technologies is a pioneering MedTech organization dedicated to innovating cutting\-edge medical technologies that are both advanced and affordable. Founded by a team of visionary technologists, S3V specializes in developing minimally invasive solutions that reduce surgical risks and improve patient recovery. Globally recognized for excellence in the cardiovascular and neurovascular segments, we are rapidly expanding our manufacturing and commercial footprint across India and international markets. Our mission is simple: to create a better world by saving lives through innovation.

**The Role**

We are seeking a high\-caliber, strategic **Recruitment Manager** to lead our Talent Acquisition engine across India. In this critical role, you will take complete ownership of building our corporate leadership, high\-performance sales, and strategic marketing teams. The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between business strategy and talent pipelines, sourcing top\-tier professionals who understand cath labs, medical device commercialization, and corporate governance. This role requires a blend of executive search sophistication, data\-driven recruitment mapping, and aggressive headhunting capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Talent Mapping \& Sourcing**

* **Pan\-India Commercial Sourcing:** Build a robust, proactive pipeline for the Sales \& Marketing division, tracking top performers from competitor medical device, pharma, and healthcare companies across key Indian clusters.
* **Executive \& Leadership Hiring:** Lead the end\-to\-end executive search process for senior management, C\-suite, and specialized technical leadership roles, maintaining a high\-touch, premium candidate experience.
* **Agile Headhunting:** Move beyond standard job boards; actively leverage LinkedIn Recruiter, clinical/industry networks, and professional forums to map out passive talent.

**Business Partnership \& Stakeholder Management**

* **Advisory Role:** Partner closely with Founders, Business Heads, and the Sales Leadership team to understand regional market dynamics and headcount requirements.
* **JD Calibration:** Conduct thorough intake meetings to define core competencies, align expectations, and create compelling mandates for complex positions.

**Operational Excellence \& Metrics**

* **Cycle\-Time Optimization:** Own and optimize recruitment metrics, including Time\-to\-Hire, Cost\-per\-Hire, Quality of Hire, and Source Mix.
* **Vendor \& Budget Management:** Evaluate, onboard, and manage specialized executive search firms and consultants, ensuring strict adherence to delivery timelines and cost\-efficiencies.
* **ATS \& Data Integrity:** Maintain immaculate data hygiene within the Applicant Tracking System (ATS) to provide regular, real\-time analytics to the executive leadership team.

**Employer Branding \& Candidate Experience**

* **Positioning S3V:** Position S3V as an employer of choice within the Indian MedTech ecosystem, communicating our vision, scale\-up trajectory, and impact on patient care.
* **Process Excellence:** Ensure a seamless, transparent, and respectful onboarding journey for all candidates, from the first contact through offer negotiation and integration.

**Required Skills \& Competencies**

* **Experience:** 10–15 years of intensive corporate recruitment or executive search experience. **A minimum of 5–8 years strictly within the Medical Device, MedTech, or Pharmaceutical industries is mandatory.**

* **Negotiation \& Acumen:** Exceptional negotiation skills with a deep understanding of corporate compensation structuring,
* **Soft Skills:** High business acumen, exceptional articulation, resilience, and a high\-ownership mindset capable of managing ambiguous, fast\-paced scale\-up environments.

title: CA Fresher (FP&A / R2R Profile)
description:
**Full Job Description:**

**About the Role:** We are hiring for a Top Fortune 500 Multinational Company (MNC) known for its excellent work culture and global presence. We are looking for highly motivated and newly qualified Chartered Accountants (CA Freshers) to join the financial team in Gurgaon. The role will focus on Financial Planning \& Analysis (FP\&A) and Record\-to\-Report (R2R) domains.

* **Position:** Business Analyst / Associate \- CA Freshers (FP\&A \& R2R)
* **Job Location:** Gurgaon (Hybrid Mode \- Candidate should be comfortable with both Work from Home and Office as per company policy)

**2\. Record\-to\-Report (R2R):**

* Management of general ledger functions, including journal entries, period\-end closing activities, and balance sheet reconciliations.
* Ensure compliance with accounting standards (IndAS / IFRS / US GAAP) and corporate internal controls.
* Assist in statutory and internal audit processes.

**Eligibility Criteria:**

* Must be a newly qualified Chartered Accountant (CA Fresher).
* Strong understanding of core accounting concepts, financial reporting, and financial modeling.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills (as the role requires interaction with global onshore clients).

**Compensation \& Benefits:**

* **Fixed Salary:** ₹8,00,000 Per Annum (Fixed)
* **Performance Bonus:** ₹1,50,000 Per Annum
* **Additional Variable Pay:** 16% to 21% of fixed compensation (Based on performance)
* Standard MNC benefits including Provident Fund (PF), Medical Insurance, and Internet/Cell phone reimbursements (as per company policy).

Pay: ₹800,000\.00 \- ₹950,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Gurgaon, Haryana

Best in the industry, based on qualifications and experience.

title: SMT Engineer
description:
We are currently seeking a skilled and detail\-oriented **SMT Engineer** to join our team in Vatva GIDC. In this role, you will be responsible for setting up, operating, and maintaining PCB assembly machinery. This includes screen printers, pick\-and\-place machines, and reflow ovens used to mount electronic components onto circuit boards. The ideal candidate will ensure compliance with safety standards and IPC specifications while maintaining smooth production line operations.

**Responsibilities:**

* Operate, monitor, and maintain SMT line equipment (screen printers, pick\-and\-place machines, reflow ovens) to ensure efficient and continuous PCB production.
* Execute machine setups, product changeovers, and component loading (feeders) strictly according to work orders and Bills of Materials (BOM).
* Conduct visual inspections and operate AOI (Automated Optical Inspection) machines to verify proper component placement and solder joint quality.
* Identify, resolve, and document minor machine malfunctions promptly to minimize production downtime.
* Carry out routine daily and weekly preventative maintenance checks on all SMT machinery.
* Maintain accurate records of production data, machine maintenance logs, and component defects.

**Experience Requirements:**

* **Experience Level:** 0 to 2\+ Years
* Freshers are welcome to apply.
* Previous experience as an SMT Operator or in electronics manufacturing is highly preferred.

The purpose of the role is to manage delivery of a project driving operations and delivery governance, ensuring right talent supply chain to optimize customer satisfaction and cost of delivery

* Ensure seamless delivery of the projects
* Deploy optimum project delivery structure post transition/ migration phase by evaluating the budget, costs, risks and staffing requirement

* Regularly audit quality (QA) status of delivery and engage QA team to ensure adherence to Quality Assurance standards and processes
* Maintain project structure in Confluence \& SAP in line with prevailing business requirements and norms
* Ensure expected ramp down (ERD) compliance as committed in MSA
* Client Relationship Management
* Engage with client to deploy opportunities to deploy multiple solutions within/ across SLs to create a stronger value proposition for clients

\- Conduct regular customer connects (meetings/ visits/ video\- conference) and participate in Management Review Meetings (MRM) with client management/engagement managers to understand customers current and future needs and seek feedback to improve delivery methodology/ timelines/ resource allocation
* Identify and close early warnings on a project to avoid any customer escalations
* Plan and conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR) along with DMs/ ADH with the client management/ leadership team to drive improvement actions and mine for a new portfolio/ opportunity within the account
* Design and monitor project performance dashboards/ reports with the clients periodically
* Delivery governance across the project
* Create weekly/ monthly/ quarterly MIS and reports to monitor and track overall project
* Conduct periodic reviews with the delivery team on operational, quality and fulfillment parameters and new idea generation \& its implementation on existing projects
* Identify and resolve potential risks or early warning signs on project delivery to drive for ZERO surprise escalations and eliminate any revenue leakage
* Escalate any deviations from the project charter to the delivery managers in terms of schedule, effort, cost, infrastructure from the project charter and minimize process exceptions and such deviations from the actual project plan
* Review and monitor revenue allocations/ realization to avoid OB revenue leakage
* Provide inputs to delivery leadership team on overall delivery performance parameters (project heath, utilization, realization etc) at project/ program level during reviews highlighting any critical project escalations and potential risks

* Automation Focus
* Perform pareto analysis as per the no. of incidents received and accordingly identify automation opportunities and drive value adds across the project
* Deploy next generation hyper automation and crowdsourcing initiatives in coordination with Holmes RO team to enhance productivity, quality and speed of delivery

  

* Interact and engage with tools team to bring in new tools in the project to automate certain pointers/ elimination of any noise in the project
* Innovation Focus
* Brainstorm with the team to identify improvement opportunities and initiatives to further improve quality, delivery speed and productivity parameters
* Drive value adds and BVMs; ensure management showcases them to customer in MRM \& QBR to drive growth
* Plan and conduct periodic idea campaigns to generate new solutions to the problems/ define better ways of working
* Drive and deploy Knowledge Management and sharing
* Contribute in internal knowledge sharing initiatives at Wipro by driving internal training sessions, best practices, learnings, value adds and BVMs and deploys best practices in various projects within own account
* Deploy the Wipro's knowledge management portal across the account and monitor \& track trainings
* Capability Development and Talent Pipeline Creation
* Demand forecasting in line with business requirements
* Anticipate attrition and ensure right talent supply chain to deliver the project
* Spearhead quarterly demand forecasting and resource planning aligned to project requirements

  

* Create and deploy a workplan to fulfil the required demand from all the talent channels including external (lateral, contractors etc) hiring in coordination with WMG/ CWMG and Talent Acquisition team
* Anticipate new skills/ upcoming technologies required to deliver the project and ensure the team is trained or right talent is inducted into the project as per the skill requirements
* Drive 100% compliance on trainings and upskilling requirements
* Prioritize and identify essential and upcoming technical skills required across programs/ projects to facilitate and drive right supply chain
* Drive towards 100% mandatory training compliance for the target population within an account
* Plan and drive rotations for seed positions and ensure replacement plan to be arrived ahead of rotations
* Quarterly connect with critical talent to understand their career aspirations and create their learning maps along with project managers and HRBP
* Fresher engagement program
* Ensure a stable arrangement and assimilation of rookie within accounts in coordination with competency group team (classroom trainings/ e\-learning, certifications, on the job training etc)
* Team Management
* Resourcing
* Forecast talent requirements as per the current and future business needs
* Hire adequate and right resources for the team
* Talent Management
* Ensure adequate onboarding and training for the team members to enhance capability \& effectiveness
* Build an internal talent pool and ensure their career progression within the organization

  

* Manage team attrition
* Drive diversity in leadership positions
* Performance Management
* Set goals for the team, conduct timely performance reviews and provide constructive feedback to own direct reports
* Ensure that the Performance Nxt is followed for the entire team
* Employee Satisfaction and Engagement
* Lead and drive engagement initiatives for the team
* Track team satisfaction scores and identify initiatives to build engagement within the team
* Facilitate rewards and recognition to acknowledge the high performers in the team
**͏**
-----

Deliver

Delivery Management ÃÂ¢Ã¢ÂÂ¬Ã¢ÂÂ Client satisfaction
  

  

PCSAT, Brand score, no. of customer references, SDR/ QBR %, Pulse % satisfied (top 2 box), Zero surprise delivery escalation from the customer, adherence to project charter
  

  

2\.
  

  

Delivery Management ÃÂ¢Ã¢ÂÂ¬Ã¢ÂÂ operational efficiency
  

  

Contractual adherence %, Quality index, Utilization %, cost of delivery target, overdue indent, 100% SLA compliance, PEI % target, 100% usage of click to bill, % SAP loss for T\&M projects

Delivery Management ÃÂ¢Ã¢ÂÂ¬Ã¢ÂÂ Financials

Capability Building

Team attrition %, Employee satisfaction score

We are Vellaration Technologies Private Limited, an innovative automation company helping businesses eliminate manual bottlenecks and scale their revenue. As we grow our tech and sales operations, we are looking for an organized, articulate, and confident HR Intern to manage our end\-to\-end talent acquisition, candidate screening, and employee relations.

**Job Description**

Are you an MBA or BBA student specializing in HR who wants real\-world experience running a company’s people operations? Do you possess excellent communication skills and the confidence to handle professional compliance and candidate screening?

We are seeking an HR Generalist Intern who will act as the backbone of our recruitment and team management. In this role, you will not just source resumes—you will manage our entire hiring pipeline on Indeed, conduct initial screening interviews, draft legal contracts, and ensure our active team maintains the highest standards of professional conduct.

**End\-to\-End Recruitment:** Post job descriptions on Indeed/LinkedIn, filter applications, and aggressively screen out candidates who lack the right technical skills or professional attitude.

**Onboarding \& Documentation:** Draft official Offer Letters and Internship Agreements for selected candidates, and follow up closely to ensure signed copies are returned before deadlines.

**Performance \& Compliance Tracking:** Keep a close eye on intern attendance, responsiveness, and deadlines.

**Workplace Discipline:** Serve as the point of contact for team accountability. Draft and issue formal warning emails or termination notices if an intern exhibits unprofessional behavior or misses core company meetings.

**Qualifications \& Required Skills**

**Education:** Currently pursuing or recently completed an MBA or BBA in Human Resources (HR).

**Communication:** Exceptional verbal and written English communication skills. You must be able to write clear, firm, and professional corporate emails.

**Tech\-Savvy:** Comfortable working with Google Workspace (Calendar, Docs, Sheets) and managing online job portals.

**Personality:** High emotional intelligence combined with a firm, professional boundary\-setting mindset. You must be comfortable addressing unprofessional behavior or enforcing company rules directly.

**What You Will Gain**

**True Autonomy:** Gain real, non\-administrative HR experience managing a live company workflow from Day 1\.

**Strategic Leadership:** Learn how a fast\-growing tech startup builds and filters its team structure.

**Documentation:** Official Internship Certificate and an executive Letter of Recommendation upon successful completion of your tenure.

**Future Employment:** Outstanding performers will be prioritized for full\-time HR Generalist positions at the company.

description:
Job Description: HR and Talent Acquisition (6\-Month Contract)

**Company:** Right Side Story LLP

**Location:** Noida, Uttar Pradesh (91springboard, Sector 1\)

**Employment Type:** Contractual (6 Months) \- On\-site

**Compensation:** ₹30,000 per month (Fixed)

**Working Hours:** 9:30 AM to 6:00 PM

**Working Days:** Monday to Friday (5\-day work week)

**Reporting To:** Manager

**Industry:** Education / Social Impact / Legal Compliance \& Child Safeguarding

About Right Side Story

Right Side Story is India’s trusted child safeguarding organization. We partner with over 1,500 educational institutions, schools, and colleges across Asia to implement robust child protection policies, conduct POCSO and POSH audits, and build legally defensible safeguarding frameworks. Through our student well\-being workshops, we empower educators, parents, and students with critical conversations around menstrual health, consent, identity, and personal safety.

By shifting the conversation from simple intent to rigorous, legally compliant practice, we are transforming school safety architecture nationally. We operate in a highly collaborative, fast\-paced environment where structural discipline meets deep social impact.

Role Overview

We are looking for a proactive, highly organized **HR and Talent Acquisition Specialist** on a **6\-month contractual basis** to spearhead our end\-to\-end recruitment process.

In this role, your sole mandate will be managing the talent pipeline. You will act as the crucial link between internal department heads and potential talent, driving the sourcing, screening, interviewing, and onboarding stages. If you are a recruiter who excels at finding the right talent, managing fast\-paced hiring cycles, and facilitating smooth candidate transitions, we want you on our team.

Key Responsibilities1\. Sourcing \& Screening (Hiring)

· **Talent Requirement Gathering:** Coordinate closely with functional heads across departments (Sales, Operations, Programs) to understand active hiring needs and skill requirements.

· **JD Creation:** Design and draft clear, compelling, and accurate Job Descriptions based on the functional requirements of each team.

· **Portal Management:** Actively utilize job boards and recruitment channels (including Naukri.com, Indeed, and LinkedIn) to source high\-quality resumes.

· **First\-Level Screening:** Review resumes, conduct first\-round screening calls to assess communication, alignment, and basic qualifications, and filter out mismatched candidates.

· **Interview Scheduling:** Coordinate calendar availability with department heads and schedule subsequent technical or functional interview rounds for shortlisted candidates.

2\. Recruitment \& Onboarding

· **Compensation Negotiation:** Initiate and manage package negotiations with selected candidates, aligning expectations with internal company budgets.

· **Offer Letters:** Draft and dispatch formal offer letters and employment contracts to selected hires with accurate terms and clauses.

· **Onboarding Support:** Facilitate a structured onboarding experience for new joiners (interns, full\-time staff, and contract\-based trainers), ensuring all necessary pre\-joining documentation is collected.

Qualifications \& Requirements

· **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resource Management, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field.

· **Experience:**

o 1 \- 2 years of dedicated experience in recruitment or talent acquisition.

o **Freshers with relevant skills** (e.g., exceptional communication skills, highly organized mindset, prior recruitment internships, or strong coordination skills) are also highly encouraged to apply.

o Experience recruiting for field\-heavy startups, EdTech, or NGOs is a major plus.

· **Hiring Expertise:** Familiarity with or hands\-on experience working with hiring portals like Naukri, Indeed, and LinkedIn to fill both corporate roles and high\-volume operations profiles.

· **Contract Commitment:** Ability to commit fully to a **6\-month, on\-site contract** in Noida.

· **Skills:**

o Strong interpersonal and negotiation skills, with the ability to close offers efficiently.

description:
**About us**

At **V7 AI Solutions LLP**, we are passionate about building AI that understands, learns, and acts on real\-world problems responsibly. Our mission is to unlock the full potential of artificial intelligence—intelligent, adaptive, autonomous, and ethical—while creating solutions that transform industries, empower organizations, and improve human lives.

At V7 AI, you’ll be part of a **dynamic, fast\-growing environment** where curiosity, creativity, and collaboration are highly valued. Working five days a week from our Bengaluru office (9:30 AM – 7:00 PM) allows our team to learn from each other, brainstorm ideas in real\-time, and build products faster and smarter.

**About the Role**

As an HR Intern at V7 AI Solutions, you will work closely with the teams to support recruitment operations, candidate coordination, onboarding activities and improving internal HR policies, employee processes, operational systems across the company.

You will also work closely with engineering team leads and hiring stakeholders to understand role requirements and support end\-to\-end hiring coordination, from candidate sourcing and screening to interview management, communication, and onboarding support.

This internship is designed for individuals who want hands\-on exposure to modern startup hiring, people operations, employer branding, and organizational coordination. You will contribute to real hiring workflows while learning how fast\-growing teams build scalable and structured people processes.

This role is highly execution\-oriented and requires strong ownership, communication and willingness to learn.

**Qualifications**

* Strong communication, coordination, and organisational skills.
* Attention to detail and ability to handle multiple tasks responsibly.
* Logical thinking, problem\-solving mindset, and willingness to learn.
* Comfortable with Google Workspace, MS Office, spreadsheets, and collaboration platforms.
* Pursuing or recently completed a degree in HR, Business Administration, Psychology, Management, or related field (preferred but not mandatory for highly driven candidates).
* Prior internship, coordination, or event management experience is a plus.
* Familiarity with LinkedIn, hiring platforms, or workflow tools is an advantage.

**Responsibilities**

Recruitment Coordination

* Assist in posting job openings across platforms such as LinkedIn, job portals, and internal channels.
* Help screen candidate applications based on defined criteria and role requirements.
* Coordinate interview schedules, assessments, and candidate communications.
* Maintain hiring trackers, candidate databases, and interview records.
* Work closely with engineering leads and hiring stakeholders to coordinate hiring activities and hiring pipeline updates.

Candidate Communication

* Send emails and follow\-ups for interviews, assessments, onboarding, and documentation.
* Act as a professional and responsive point of contact for candidates during the hiring process.
* Ensure candidates receive timely updates and clear communication throughout their journey.

HR Operations \& Onboarding

* Assist in onboarding activities including documentation collection, employee data entry, and induction coordination.
* Support HR administrative processes and maintain organized records.
* Coordinate with internal teams for onboarding readiness and operational requirements.

Process Improvement \& Automation

* Help identify repetitive manual tasks and support process optimization initiatives.
* Assist in improving trackers, templates, workflows, and reporting systems.
* Explore simple automation opportunities using spreadsheets, forms, AI tools, or workflow platforms.

**Who Thrives Here**

* Takes full ownership of follow\-ups, scheduling, documentation, and stakeholder coordination without needing step\-by\-step direction.
* Thinks in systems — able to spot inefficiencies and improve processes through optimisation or automation.
* Handles high\-volume coordination work without losing accuracy or attention to detail.
* Communicates confidently with candidates, founders, hiring managers, and engineering leads.
* Comfortable with fast\-paced environments where priorities shift and timelines are tight.
* High learning agility — quickly understands business, hiring, and operational contexts.
* Disciplined in maintaining records, trackers, reports, and operational consistency.
* Curious about AI tools, automation, and operational efficiency improvements.
* We value execution quality, ownership, and structured thinking — more than credentials alone.
* Candidates who rely on templates without understanding context may struggle in this role.

**This Role May Not Be a Good Fit If**

* You prefer repetitive work with fixed instructions for every task.
* You struggle with follow\-ups, coordination, or maintaining operational discipline.
* You are uncomfortable with fast\-paced environments where priorities evolve quickly.
* You dislike structured documentation, tracking systems, or process\-oriented work.
* You prefer low\-ownership environments with limited accountability.

**Internship Structure**

* **The duration of the internship is 3 months.**
* Interns who demonstrate strong performance, design ownership, learning ability, and meaningful contribution may be considered for internship extension

**Who You Will Work With**

You will work closely with the Directors, Operations, and Engineering teams at V7 AI Solutions — gaining exposure to cross\-functional collaboration and real\-world startup operations.

**What You Will Learn**

During this internship, you will gain practical exposure to:

* Recruitment operations
* Candidate lifecycle management
* Employer branding
* HR operations and onboarding
* Hiring coordination and stakeholder management
* Process management and workflow optimisation
* Startup execution and organisational systems

**What Success Looks Like**

* Hiring coordination runs smoothly and efficiently.
* Candidates receive timely and professional communication.
* Recruitment and onboarding records remain accurate and organised.
* Internal teams receive reliable operational support.
* HR workflows become more structured, scalable, and efficient over time.

**Why Join Us**

At V7 AI Solutions, you will work in a fast\-moving environment where your contribution directly impacts hiring quality and operational efficiency.

This internship is ideal for individuals who enjoy solving operational problems, coordinating execution, improving systems, and contributing meaningfully in a high\-ownership startup environment.

* Act as the **primary HR point of contact** for UK clients and internal delivery teams.
* Provide timely updates on hiring, onboarding, BGV, and consultant status.

* Excellent **English communication**and stakeholder management skills.
* Proficiency in **MS Excel, Google Sheets, HRMS/ATS tools**.
* Strong attention to detail, process orientation, and ability to work independently.

-------------

--------------------

--------------------------

* Strong client satisfaction and communication quality.
* Smooth compliance and BGV completion.

**Company Overview**

Cyberchrome Private Limited is a fast\-growing IT and business development company focused on building structured, scalable systems for startups and premium clients. We specialize in business development solutions, digital infrastructure, and strategic growth support.

We are transitioning from a local service model to a **premium client\-focused organization**, and we are looking for a strong HR leader to build and manage a professional workforce system.

**Skills**

* Strong leadership and decision\-making ability
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Deep understanding of organizational structure and HR systems
* Ability to handle pressure and enforce discipline
* Strategic thinking \+ execution capability

**Role Objective**

The HR Head will be responsible for designing, implementing, and managing the entire HR system of Cyberchrome. This role is focused on building a **structured, disciplined, and performance\-driven team culture** aligned with business growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

1\. HR System Development

* Design and implement complete HR policies and SOPs
* Build a structured organizational hierarchy (Team Leaders, Departments, Reporting flow)
* Develop employee lifecycle systems (Hiring → Onboarding → Performance → Exit)
* Ensure the company operates in a **system\-driven structure, not person\-dependent**

2\. Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition

* Plan and execute hiring strategies for all departments
* Create job descriptions and hiring pipelines
* Conduct interviews and shortlist high\-quality candidates
* Focus on hiring **growth\-oriented and disciplined professionals**

3\. Performance Management System

* Implement KPI\-based performance tracking
* Monitor employee productivity and efficiency
* Coordinate with team leaders for performance reviews
* Develop reward, incentive, and penalty systems

4\. Employee Discipline \& Culture

* Maintain strict professional communication systems
* Ensure no direct dependency between employees and top management (structured communication only through team leaders)
* Build a **high\-performance, no\-nonsense work culture**
* Handle employee conflicts and disciplinary actions

5\. Training \& Development

* Identify skill gaps and organize training programs
* Develop onboarding training systems for new employees
* Improve team productivity through continuous learning

6\. Payroll \& Compliance

* Manage salary structures, attendance, and leave systems
* Ensure compliance with labor laws and company policies
* Coordinate with accounts for payroll processing

7\. HR Analytics \& Reporting

* Track hiring metrics, employee performance, and retention rates
* Provide regular reports to management
* Suggest improvements based on data
