**Job Overview:** We are looking for a **Customer Relationship Executive** who will serve as a vital link between SuperProcure and our clients. Your primary responsibility will be to proactively follow up with clients, understand their ongoing context, and follow up with necessary stakeholders till the task is completed.


This role requires a unique blend of **patience, persistence, and high motivation** to get things done through structured communication. If you are someone who stays calm under pressure, loves engaging with people, and can systematically drive tasks to completion, this role is for you.


#### **Key Responsibilities**


* **Client Follow\-ups:** Proactively call clients daily to follow up on pending tasks, actions, and milestones.
* **Data \& Context Management:** Listen actively to understand the client's current context/challenges and capture these insights accurately and communicate to internal stakeholders.
* **System Updates:** Maintain accurate, real\-time records of whether tasks are "done" or "pending" within our internal systems
* **Direct Reporting:** Work closely with and report directly to the Leadership **Team** to share daily progress reports, client bottlenecks, and updates.
* **Future Growth:** As the team expands, this function will scale into a larger pool of specialists dedicated solely to client engagement and data collection, offering early team\-leading opportunities.

#### **Requirements**


* **The Persona:** Highly calm, composed, and patient. You should possess a polite yet persistent attitude to drive work out of other people without friction.
* **Communication Skills:** Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
* **Language Fluency:** Absolute fluency in **Hindi** and **English** is mandatory. Proficiency in any additional regional languages is a major advantage.
* **Tech Savviness:** Basic comfort with using software tools, google sheets or excel
* **Ownership:** A strong sense of accountability and self\-motivation to hit daily follow\-up targets.

#### **What’s in it for You?**


* Direct mentorship and visibility working closely with leadership
* A clear growth path into a senior or managerial role as this specific function scales up.
* A supportive, energetic, and collaborative work culture.

**Other Detail****s**

* No. of positions \- 1
* CTC\- 2\.5 – 3\.5 LPA
* Location\- Kolkata

**About SuperProcure**


SuperProcure is a next\-generation end\-to\-end TMS platform with multi\-enterprise collaboration for shippers. It digitizes and automates all processes across the logistics value chain from vehicle sourcing to freight accounting, ensuring stakeholder collaboration, real\-time visibility \& transparency. We are determined to make the lives of the logistic teams easier, add value, and help in establishing a fair and beneficial process for businesses. SuperProcure is trusted by a diverse customer base spread across manufacturing \& construction industries to boost their customer serviceability with cutting\-edge technology solutions.


Indian logistics spent is 14% of GDP, against 7\-9% in developed countries. This makes the Indian industries less competitive in the international market and extra spent for domestic consumers. The logistics inefficiency is driven by manual processes spread across multiple stakeholders who work in silos to complete transportation of goods.


SuperProcure aims to revolutionize Indian logistics to save 1% of GDP spending and make India globally competitive, enabling collaboration on a single platform, and driving logistics efficiencies.


Our clients include some of the fortune 500 companies such as Tata Chemicals, Havells, KEI, ITC, PepsiCo, Tata Consumers, Dawaat, L\&T Constructions, Aditya Birla, MP Birla Corporation, Sun Pharma, many more.


SuperProcure is backed by IndiaMart \& IIM Calcutta. It has been recognized for its innovation at the CII Industrial Innovation Awards, was recognized amongst the Top 50 Emerging start\-ups in India by NASSCOM, and ranked Asia's top 10 TMS solution providers by the Global Supply Chain Council (GSCC) and ChainTech.


**Life @ SuperProcure**


SuperProcure operates in an extremely innovative, entrepreneurial, analytical, and problem\-solving work culture. Every team member is fully motivated and committed to the company's vision and believes in getting things done. In our organization, every employee is the CEO of what he/she does; from conception to execution, the work needs to be thought through.


Our people are the core of our organization, and we believe in empowering them and making them a part of the daily decision\-making, which impacts the business and shapes the company's overall strategy. They are constantly provided with resources, mentorship, and support from our highly energetic teams and leadership. SuperProcure is extremely inclusive and believes in collective success.


Looking for a bland, routine 9\-6 job? PLEASE DO NOT APPLY. Looking for a job where you wake up and add significant value to a $180 Billion logistics industry every day? DO APPLY.


**Team:** SuperProcure's success is fueled by our diverse \& talented team of 150\+ members, 50%\+ of whom are women. Together, we collaborate with a shared passion for innovation and excellence. From visionary leaders \& meticulous engineers to creative designers \& customer support specialists, each plays a crucial role in our growth. We build lasting relationships, understand unique needs, and exceed expectations by delivering cutting\-edge tailored solutions.


**Culture:** All challenges and fun associated with start\-ups. Competitive salary, responsibilities, flat hierarchy, daily challenges, long working hours, delivery pressure, and a fun workplace.

The Purchase Executive in Supply Chain Management (SCM) is responsible for managing the procurement of raw materials, components, and services required for the manufacturing process. This role involves negotiating with suppliers, ensuring timely delivery, maintaining inventory levels, and optimizing costs while adhering to quality standards.

**Key Responsibilities:**

	+ Source and procure raw materials, components, and services from local and international suppliers.

	+ Evaluate and select suppliers based on quality, cost, delivery, and service.

**About Us:**  
Poona Pneumatic Private Limited (Flow Air Group) was established in 1987, as an authorized dealer for ELGi air compressors and automotive equipment. title: Geriatric Business Associate
description:
**Location:** \[Gurgaon, Bengaluru]

**Experience:** Fresher/ 1\+ Years in a hospital\-based clinical nursing role

**1\. The Strategic Mandate: You are the First Clinical Voice of Emoha**

Your mission is to be the first, most trusted clinical point of contact for families seeking care. You are the expert who translates a family's concern and an elder's needs into a clear, compassionate, and effective home care plan. You will use your deep clinical judgment to conduct virtual assessments, building immediate trust and ensuring that we design and deploy the *exact right* care for every elderly person we serve. Your work is the foundation upon which our promise of quality and peace of mind is built.

**2\. Core Accountabilities \& Measures of Success**

Your performance is measured by the quality, accuracy, and effectiveness of the care plans you create and the trust you build with families.

Core Accountability

Key Activities \& Responsibilities

Primary KPIs

**1\. Clinical Assessment \& Needs Analysis**

Conduct structured, empathetic, and thorough nursing assessments via video/tele\-call for pre\-qualified inbound leads. Use clinical expertise to accurately identify the elder's care requirements.

**Quality of Assessment Score** (audited). **Time to Complete Assessment.**

**2\. Care Plan Architecture**

Based on your assessment, design a precise and appropriate home care solution, recommending the right mix of services (e.g., GDA, Nurse, medical equipment).

**Care Plan Accuracy Rate** (% of plans matching actual needs upon physical validation). **First Time Right %** (minimal changes needed post\-deployment).

**3\. Seamless Handover to Deployment Team**

Create clear, concise, and accurate documentation and provide a flawless verbal handover of the care plan to the Carer relationship team (CRT) for deployment.

**Handover Efficiency \& Clarity Score** (rated by CRT). **Time from Assessment to Deployment.**

**4\. Trust Building \& Conversion**

Act as a compassionate advisor to families, clearly explaining your recommendations and building the confidence that leads them to choose Emoha for their loved one's care.

**Lead\-to\-Conversion Rate (%).** **Family Satisfaction Score** (post\-assessment).

**3\. The Success Profile: Core Competencies**

We hire for a rare combination of deep clinical skill and exceptional human connection.

Competency

Definition for This Role

"Exceptional Mastery" Looks Like...

**1\. The Clinical Detective**

This is your core nursing skill. It is the ability to use your sharp observational and questioning skills to uncover the full picture of an elder's health, even in a virtual setting.

You don't just take the family's request at face value. You ask the insightful follow\-up questions that help you differentiate between what they *think* they need and what the elder *actually* requires for safe and effective care.

**2\. The Empathetic Translator**

This is your communication superpower. It is the ability to listen with genuine compassion and then explain complex clinical needs and care solutions in simple, reassuring, jargon\-free language.

You can build immediate rapport with a worried family member. You are fluent in English and can switch to a local dialect (e.g., Hindi, etc.) to ensure an elderly person feels comfortable and understood, making them feel heard and respected.

**3\. The Care Plan Architect**

This is your problem\-solving ability. It is the skill of taking your clinical findings and perfectly matching them to the right Emoha resources—never over\-selling or under\-serving.

You are a master of "right\-sizing" care. You can confidently and correctly determine if an elder needs a GDA for mobility support, a certified Nurse for clinical tasks, or specific equipment like an oxygen concentrator, creating the perfect, cost\-effective plan.

**4\. The Flawless Bridge\-Builder**

This is your operational discipline. It is the ability to create documentation that is so clear, accurate, and well\-structured that the deployment team can execute your plan with speed and precision, without any ambiguity.

Your handover notes are the "source of truth." The CRT trusts your assessments implicitly because they are consistently thorough and accurate, which prevents errors and ensures the elder gets the right care from the very first day.

**4\. Required Experience \& Qualifications**

* **Qualification:** Must be a Registered Nurse with a degree in GNM or B.Sc. Nursing.
* **Experience:** Fresher or a minimum of **1 year of hands\-on clinical experience in an acute care hospital setting** (e.g., ICU, Medical\-Surgical ward, Emergency Room). This is non\-negotiable.
* **Skills:**

§ Excellent clinical assessment and critical thinking skills.

§ Exceptional verbal communication and listening skills.

§ **High proficiency in English and at least one or more local dialects is a strong advantage.**

§ Comfortable and proficient with technology (video calls, computers, CRM systems).

**5\. You Will Thrive at Emoha If You Are:**

* **A Natural Problem\-Solver:** You love the diagnostic aspect of nursing and the satisfaction of figuring out the perfect solution.
* **An Exceptional Listener:** You believe that the most important part of an assessment is making the family and the elderly feel truly heard.
* **Meticulous and Detail\-Oriented:** You take immense pride in your accuracy and your ability to create clear, well\-documented plans.
* **Empathetic and Reassuring:** You have a natural ability to create a sense of calm and confidence, even in stressful situations.

**Excited to Use Your Clinical Skills in an Innovative Way:** You are motivated by the opportunity to be at the forefront of digital healthcare delivery

title: Website Designer and Developer
description:
Website Designer \& Developer

**Location:** Kochi, Kerala  
**Salary:** ₹25,000 – ₹35,000 per month (Based on Skills \& Experience)  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time \| On\-Site  
**Joining:** Immediate Joiners Preferred

About the Role

We are looking for a creative and technically skilled **Website Designer \& Developer** to join our Kochi office. The ideal candidate should be capable of designing, developing, managing, and maintaining professional websites for legal, corporate, media, technology, consulting, and business\-related projects.

The candidate should possess strong design aesthetics along with practical web development skills to create modern, responsive, user\-friendly, and conversion\-focused websites.

Key ResponsibilitiesWebsite Design \& Development

* Design and develop modern, responsive, and mobile\-friendly websites.
* Create visually appealing layouts, landing pages, and user interfaces.
* Build and maintain websites using WordPress and other CMS platforms.
* Develop websites for corporate, legal, e\-commerce, media, and business projects.
* Ensure websites are optimized for speed, performance, and user experience.
* Implement responsive designs across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

Website Management \& Maintenance

* Manage website updates, content uploads, backups, and security.
* Monitor website performance and resolve technical issues.
* Maintain hosting, domain, SSL, and related website infrastructure.
* Ensure website functionality and uptime.

UI/UX \& Creative Design

* Design intuitive user experiences and website structures.
* Create wireframes, mockups, banners, icons, graphics, and web assets.
* Improve website navigation, engagement, and conversion rates.
* Ensure brand consistency across all digital properties.

SEO \& Digital Optimization

* Implement basic on\-page SEO practices.
* Optimize website speed and search engine visibility.
* Integrate analytics, tracking tools, forms, and lead\-generation systems.
* Support digital marketing initiatives through website optimization.

Technical Integration

* Integrate payment gateways, CRM systems, forms, APIs, and third\-party tools where required.
* Coordinate with marketing, content, design, and management teams.
* Support future web\-based products and internal systems.

Required Skills

* WordPress Development
* Website Design \& UI/UX
* HTML, CSS, JavaScript
* Responsive Web Design
* Elementor or Similar Builders
* Website Optimization \& Performance
* Domain \& Hosting Management
* Basic SEO Knowledge
* Website Security \& Maintenance
* Graphic Design Fundamentals

Preferred Skills

Experience in one or more of:

* WordPress
* Elementor
* WooCommerce
* Shopify
* PHP
* React
* Bootstrap
* Figma
* Adobe Photoshop
* Adobe Illustrator
* Canva
* Webflow

Preferred Qualifications

* Degree/Diploma in Computer Science, Web Design, Software Development, Multimedia, UI/UX, or related fields.
* Freshers with strong portfolios may apply.
* Prior experience in website design, development, UI/UX, or digital projects is preferred.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who:

* Has strong creative and technical abilities.
* Can independently manage website projects from concept to deployment.
* Pays close attention to detail.
* Understands branding, user experience, and business objectives.
* Can work efficiently in a fast\-paced environment.
* Is eager to learn and grow with the organization.

Additional Requirements

* Immediate joining preferred.
* Must be willing to work from Kochi office.
* Strong communication and coordination skills.
* Portfolio, live website links, GitHub profile, or previous project samples must be shared during application.

Compensation \& Benefits

* Salary: ₹25,000 – ₹35,000 per month.

* Write whitepapers/ research papers, point of views and share with the consulting community at large

title: Case Mgr, S/L [S], Standalone
description:
**Description**
 This is a contractual role
   

  

 At Amazon we believe that every day is still day one.
   

  

 We are working to be the most customer\-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you’d like to help the Disability Leave Services (DLS) team build a best\-in\-class professional services program to deliver leave of absence, disability and accommodation services to Amazon employees, applicants, job seekers and candidates globally, this is your chance to make history by joining the amazing Disability \& Leave Services Team.
   

  

 The DLS Case Manager provides case management for all types of leave of absence and disability life events. The DLS Case Manager is highly skilled in answering questions, understanding the employee’s situation, applying the appropriate benefits, responding to changing circumstances and needs, and paves the way for a connected and trusted case management experience. Case Managers are the single point of contact for an employee throughout an entire leave of absence or disability event.
   

  

 This is an individual contribution (IC) role with no direct reports.
   

  

**Essential Responsibilities**
* Initiate and respond to inquiries about leave and disability events, benefits, and options available to employees
* Serve as a point of contact for assigned employees to provide holistic case management services, including reviewing medical documentation to adjudicate leaves in compliance with the corresponding leave plans, federal and state laws and benefit plans as defined by Amazon
* Leverage duration guidelines, best practice tools and Amazon resources to support oversight of a leave event as appropriate
* Critically assess and adjust the case management plan to an employee’s changing needs
* Address and respond to sensitive situations
* Troubleshoot issues and seek to remove barriers before, during, or after a leave event
* Respond to employee impacting issues that may arise during the leave event and ensure the right communication occurs
* Identify and solve problems that may arise, sometimes with limited information
* Facilitate a smooth return to work and ramp\-back plan for employees returning to the workplace
* Educate managers and business partners on employee concerns and needs prior to being off or returning back to work
* Communicate regular updates to employees and stakeholders both verbally and in writing
* Ensure compliance with standard work, federal/state regulations, and company policy
* Maintain system records to ensure accurate and timely information/documentation
* Consult, coordinate and partner with our third party administrator, HR, Safety, Legal, Payroll, Benefits, team members and other departments/systems as appropriate
* Other duties as assigned


 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 The DLS Case Manager serving as the single point of contact for employees throughout their entire leave or disability experience.
   

  

 Initiate and respond to inquiries regarding leave and disability events, benefits, and available options
   

  

 Provide holistic case management including reviewing medical documentation and adjudicating leaves in compliance with federal/state laws, leave plans, and company policy
   

  

 Leverage duration guidelines, best practice tools, and internal resources to manage leave events effectively
   

  

 Assess and adjust case management plans based on employees' changing needs and circumstances
   

  

 Address sensitive situations with professionalism and resolve barriers before, during, or after leave events
   

  

 Identify and solve problems proactively, sometimes with limited information
   

  

 Facilitate smooth return\-to\-work and ramp\-back plans for employees resuming duties
   

  

 Educate managers and business partners on employee needs related to leave transitions
   

  

 Communicate regular updates to employees and stakeholders verbally and in writing
   

  

 Maintain accurate system records and documentation in a timely manner
   

  

 Ensure compliance with standard work processes, federal/state regulations, and company policy
   

  

 Coordinate with third\-party administrators, HR, Safety, Legal, Payroll, Benefits, and other departments as needed
   

  

 This is an individual contributor (IC) role with no direct reports.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 Daily activities include reviewing and adjudicating medical documentation, responding to employee and stakeholder inquiries, and updating case records in real time. Case Managers assess evolving employee needs, troubleshoot barriers, and coordinate with HR, Legal, Payroll, Safety, and third\-party administrators to resolve issues. They communicate decisions, next steps, and status updates to employees and managers both verbally and in writing. Additional activities include facilitating return\-to\-work plans, educating business partners on leave\-related processes, and ensuring all actions comply with federal/state regulations and company policy. Case Managers proactively identify risks, escalate sensitive situations, and apply best practice tools to drive timely case resolution
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a related field
* 2\+ years of customer service experience, or Bachelor's degree in business, HR, or a related field
* Experience in direct customer support
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree
* Experience working with and protecting confidential and sensitive HR information
* Experience with process improvement and stakeholder management
* Experience and knowledge in Six Sigma belts and process improvement initiatives.

 •     Ensure full compliance with applicable labour laws — Factories Act, ESI, PF, Professional Tax, Contract Labour (Regulation \& Abolition) Act, and Shops \& Establishment Act.

 •     Drive employee engagement initiatives to build a positive, retention\-focused factory culture.
 





 •     Ensure safety compliance and welfare measures in line with factory regulations.
 





 •     Conduct exit interviews, manage Full \& Final settlements, and track attrition trends.
 





  
 




**HR Operations \& Process Building** 





 •     Build and document HR SOPs, policies, and processes from the ground up for a fast\-scaling manufacturing setup.
 





 •     Coordinate manpower planning with the production team based on order volumes and production schedules.
 





 •     Drive training and development programs for factory staff — skill upgradation, safety, and compliance training.
 




  





**What We’re Looking For** 




  





**Must\-Have**

 •     Experience managing blue\-collar workforce recruitment, payroll, and compliance.
 





 •     Proficiency in attendance management systems and basic MS Excel / Google Sheets.
 





 •     Comfortable communicating in Kannada and Hindi with factory floor staff; English for management reporting.
 





  
 




**Good to Have**

title: Customer Relationship Executive
description:
**Job Title****: Customer Relationship Executive**

**Department****: MDO**

**Location****: Kolkata (In Office)**

**Experience****: Fresher to 1 Year (Open to enthusiastic freshers!)**

**Work Schedule\-** **Monday to Saturday**

**Job Overview:** We are looking for a **Customer Relationship Executive** who will serve as a vital link between SuperProcure and our clients. Your primary responsibility will be to proactively follow up with clients, understand their ongoing context, and follow up with necessary stakeholders till the task is completed.


This role requires a unique blend of **patience, persistence, and high motivation** to get things done through structured communication. If you are someone who stays calm under pressure, loves engaging with people, and can systematically drive tasks to completion, this role is for you.

#### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Client Follow\-ups:** Proactively call clients daily to follow up on pending tasks, actions, and milestones.
* **Data \& Context Management:** Listen actively to understand the client's current context/challenges and capture these insights accurately and communicate to internal stakeholders.
* **System Updates:** Maintain accurate, real\-time records of whether tasks are "done" or "pending" within our internal systems
* **Direct Reporting:** Work closely with and report directly to the Leadership **Team** to share daily progress reports, client bottlenecks, and updates.
* **Future Growth:** As the team expands, this function will scale into a larger pool of specialists dedicated solely to client engagement and data collection, offering early team\-leading opportunities.

#### **Requirements**

* **The Persona:** Highly calm, composed, and patient. You should possess a polite yet persistent attitude to drive work out of other people without friction.
* **Communication Skills:** Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
* **Language Fluency:** Absolute fluency in **Hindi** and **English** is mandatory. Proficiency in any additional regional languages is a major advantage.
* **Tech Savviness:** Basic comfort with using software tools, google sheets or excel
* **Ownership:** A strong sense of accountability and self\-motivation to hit daily follow\-up targets.

#### **What’s in it for You?**

* Direct mentorship and visibility working closely with leadership
* A clear growth path into a senior or managerial role as this specific function scales up.
* A supportive, energetic, and collaborative work culture.

**Other Detail****s**

* No. of positions \- 1
* CTC\- 2\.5 – 3\.5 LPA
* Location\- Kolkata

**About SuperProcure**


SuperProcure is a next\-generation end\-to\-end TMS platform with multi\-enterprise collaboration for shippers. It digitizes and automates all processes across the logistics value chain from vehicle sourcing to freight accounting, ensuring stakeholder collaboration, real\-time visibility \& transparency. We are determined to make the lives of the logistic teams easier, add value, and help in establishing a fair and beneficial process for businesses. SuperProcure is trusted by a diverse customer base spread across manufacturing \& construction industries to boost their customer serviceability with cutting\-edge technology solutions.


Indian logistics spent is 14% of GDP, against 7\-9% in developed countries. This makes the Indian industries less competitive in the international market and extra spent for domestic consumers. The logistics inefficiency is driven by manual processes spread across multiple stakeholders who work in silos to complete transportation of goods.


SuperProcure aims to revolutionize Indian logistics to save 1% of GDP spending and make India globally competitive, enabling collaboration on a single platform, and driving logistics efficiencies.


Our clients include some of the fortune 500 companies such as Tata Chemicals, Havells, KEI, ITC, PepsiCo, Tata Consumers, Dawaat, L\&T Constructions, Aditya Birla, MP Birla Corporation, Sun Pharma, many more.


SuperProcure is backed by IndiaMart \& IIM Calcutta. It has been recognized for its innovation at the CII Industrial Innovation Awards, was recognized amongst the Top 50 Emerging start\-ups in India by NASSCOM, and ranked Asia's top 10 TMS solution providers by the Global Supply Chain Council (GSCC) and ChainTech. More details about our journey can be found here


**Life @ SuperProcure**


SuperProcure operates in an extremely innovative, entrepreneurial, analytical, and problem\-solving work culture. Every team member is fully motivated and committed to the company's vision and believes in getting things done. In our organization, every employee is the CEO of what he/she does; from conception to execution, the work needs to be thought through.


Our people are the core of our organization, and we believe in empowering them and making them a part of the daily decision\-making, which impacts the business and shapes the company's overall strategy. They are constantly provided with resources, mentorship, and support from our highly energetic teams and leadership. SuperProcure is extremely inclusive and believes in collective success.


Looking for a bland, routine 9\-6 job? PLEASE DO NOT APPLY. Looking for a job where you wake up and add significant value to a $180 Billion logistics industry every day? DO APPLY.


**Team:** SuperProcure's success is fueled by our diverse \& talented team of 150\+ members, 50%\+ of whom are women. Together, we collaborate with a shared passion for innovation and excellence. From visionary leaders \& meticulous engineers to creative designers \& customer support specialists, each plays a crucial role in our growth. We build lasting relationships, understand unique needs, and exceed expectations by delivering cutting\-edge tailored solutions.


**Culture:** All challenges and fun associated with start\-ups. Competitive salary, responsibilities, flat hierarchy, daily challenges, long working hours, delivery pressure, and a fun workplace.

title: Business Intelligence Engineer, APAC Retail BI

**Description**
 Amazon has an exciting opportunity for a Business Intelligence Engineer to join our online retail team. The Retail team operates as a merchant in Amazon, the team owns functions like merchandising, marketing, inventory management, vendor management and program management as core functions. In this pivotal role, you’ll be supporting these functions with business intelligence you derive from our vast array of data and will play a role in the long term growth and success of Amazon in the APAC region.
   

  

 You will be working with stakeholders from Pricing Program to contribute to Amazon’s Pricing strategies, partnering with Vendor and Inventory managers to help improve product cost structures, supporting the marketing team to build their strategies by using extremely large volumes of complex data. You will be exploring datasets, writing complex SQL queries, building data pipelines and data visualization solutions with AWS Quicksight. You will be also building new Machine Learning models to predict the outcomes of key inputs.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As a BI Engineer in the APAC Retail BI team, you will build constructive partnerships with key stakeholders that enable your business understanding and ability to develop true business insights and recommendations. You’ll have the opportunity to work with other BI experts locally and internationally to identify to learn and develop best practices, always applying a data\- driven approach. Amazon is widely known for our obsession over customers. In this role your stakeholders will be counting on you to help us understand customer behaviour and improve our offerings.
   

  

 This role does include periodic reporting responsibilities, but it’s really much more diverse than that. If this role is right for you, you will enjoy the challenge of pivoting between ad\-hoc pieces of analysis, reporting enhancement, new builds as well as working on long\-term strategic projects to enhance the BI \& Analytics capabilities in Amazon.

* 2\+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
**About The Company**
 Netspend Corporation is a global, vertically\-integrated financial services and technology company dedicated to the delivery of innovative financial empowerment solutions to consumers worldwide. Netspend's financial products and services span prepaid, debit, cross\-border payments, and loyalty solutions for consumers and enterprise partners.
   

  

 Netspend provides prepaid and debit account solutions that connect customers with secure, convenient access to global payment networks so they can manage their money and make everyday purchases. With a nationwide U.S. retail network, customers can purchase and reload Netspend products at 130,000 reload points and over 100,000 distributing locations.
   

  

 Since our founding in 1999 by industry pioneers, Netspend products have processed billions of dollars in transaction volume and served millions of customers worldwide. The company is headquartered in Austin, Texas with employees worldwide.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 As a Senior Network Engineer, you will be responsible for the architecture, deployment, and optimization of our global, high\-availability network infrastructure across data centers and AWS cloud environments. Your role involves expert\-level knowledge in managing complex enterprise routing and switching, designing and maintaining enterprise Wireless Infrastructure (Cisco Meraki), configuring enterprise\-grade firewalls (e.g., Palo Alto), and integrating hybrid cloud solutions. You will bridge the gap between high\-level business goals and technical execution, ensuring our network is cost\-optimized, secure by design, and resilient.
   

  

**Required Skills**
* Bachelor’s Degree and 7\+ years of experience in Network Engineering
* Expert\-level knowledge in designing and maintaining scalable, high\-availability network solutions across global data centers and AWS cloud environments.
* Proven ability to manage communication and coordination with external vendors and partners for timely resolution of network service issues.
* Proficiency in managing complex enterprise routing and switching
* Proven experience in designing, deploying, and optimizing enterprise Wireless Technologies.
* Hands on experience on handing Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE)
* In\-depth knowledge of AWS Networking components, including VPCs, Transit Gateways, Direct Connect, and Client VPNs, for hybrid cloud integration.
* Hands\-on experience configuring and maintaining enterprise\-grade firewalls (e.g., Palo Alto, Fortinet etc.).
* Familiarity with data center technologies such as VXLAN, EVPN, or Cisco ACI.
* Strong competency in proactive network health monitoring, troubleshooting complex Layer 2 and Layer 3 issues, and leading Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
* Ability to manage physical hardware lifecycle (racking, stacking, and cabling) and oversee server room environmental monitoring, power distribution (PDU), and UPS systems.


**Key Responsibilities**
* Network Architecture: Design and maintain scalable, high\-availability network solutions across global data centers and AWS cloud environments.
* Routing \& Switching: Manage complex enterprise environments utilizing BGP, OSPF, and EIGRP.
* Wireless Infrastructure: Design, deploy, and optimize enterprise Wi\-Fi using Cisco Meraki, ensuring seamless roaming, high density, and secure guest/corporate access.
* Hybrid Cloud Integration: Design and manage AWS Networking components, including VPCs, Transit Gateways, Direct Connect, and Client VPNs.
* Security \& Firewalls: Configure and maintain enterprise\-grade firewalls (e.g., Palo Alto, Fortinet, or Cisco Firepower) to protect critical assets.
* Data Center \& Server Room Management:
+ Manage physical hardware lifecycle (racking, stacking, and cabling).
+ Oversee server room environmental monitoring, power distribution (PDU), and UPS systems.
+ Maintain data center technologies such as VXLAN, EVPN, or Cisco ACI.

* Performance Monitoring: Proactively monitor network health, troubleshoot complex Layer 2 and Layer 3 issues, and lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA) efforts.
* Cisco Identity Services Engine


**Mandatory Certifications (Anyone)**
* SISE \- Implementing and Configuring Cisco Identity Services Engine
* DCACI \- Implementing Cisco Application Centric Infrastructure
* PCNSE \- Network Security Administrator


**Preferred Certifications**
* CCNP/CCIE \- Cisco Certified Network Professional or Similar
* AWS Certified Advanced Networking \- Specialty

**General Summary**
 At Qualcomm XR Research, we develop state\-of\-the\-art XR technologies that enable exceptional AR/VR/MR user experiences.
   

  

 We are looking for a Staff Engineer to own and drive validation of perception systems for XR (AR/VR/MR) technologies. * Evaluate performance across sensors, calibrations, environments, and system configurations.
* Define and evolve perception KPIs (pose accuracy, drift, stability/jitter, robustness, reconstruction quality).
* Perform mathematical and statistical analysis of logs, trajectories, and 3D outputs.
* Identify and implement automation opportunities to improve test coverage, repeatability, and efficiency.
* Perform preliminary root\-cause analysis of perception failures and regressions.

* Experience with large log analysis, offline processing, and metrics generation.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical issues clearly.
* Proven ability to work across teams and support stakeholder debugging needs.


**Preferred**
* 9\+ years of relevant industry experience in perception systems, computer vision, robotics, or XR technologies.
* M.Tech / MS in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related technical field.
* Experience with XR, AR/VR/MR, robotics, or autonomous systems.
* Familiarity with tools such as GTSAM, Ceres, OpenCV, ROS, or similar libraries.
* Experience with ground\-truth systems (motion capture, GNSS, fiducials).

description:

 Join us as we create something extraordinary together.
   

  

 The Senior Scrum Master plays a pivotal role in driving agile transformation within the organization. This position is responsible for facilitating effective delivery across teams, ensuring adherence to SAFe guidelines, and championing continuous improvement. The ideal candidate will possess strong leadership abilities, a proactive approach to risk and issue management, and a proven track record in guiding complex projects to successful outcomes.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Provide support for 1\-2 teams with medium to high complexities and dependencies
* Proactively manage risks and issues or impediments by identifying potential impacts, target resolution dates, owners, and mitigation strategies, while ensuring timely and effective resolution.
* Facilitate Scaling Agile Framework (SAFe) ceremonies and ensure adherence to SAFe guidelines to enhance team alignment and productivity. Lead Program Increment (PI) planning sessions and provide support to teams in meeting PI objectives. Oversee daily Scrum and Kanban activities, including the facilitation of stand\-ups, backlog refinement, and workflow optimization.

* Ensure compliance with Change and Release standards and guidelines. Appropriately prioritize and plan the remediation of production defects, incidents, and problem records.
* Ensure adherence to Enterprise EPMO standards, guidelines, and governance frameworks across all assigned Agile teams, aligning delivery practices with organizational expectations and controls.
* Track, report, and continuously improve against Enterprise EPMO governance metrics, including delivery health, predictability, risk, dependency management, and compliance indicators.
* Partner with the Enterprise EPMO, Release Train Engineers, and Program Leadership to support governance reviews, audits, and readiness checkpoints as required.
* Ensure transparency and accuracy of Agile metrics and artifacts to support Enterprise EPMO reporting, executive dashboards, and decision\-making.

**Required Skills And Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience.
* Minimum of 3 years’ experience as a Scrum Master in agile environments.
* In\-depth knowledge of SAFe principles, Agile methodologies, and project management best practices.
* Demonstrated ability to manage risks and issues proactively in complex projects.
* Exceptional facilitation and communication skills, with experience leading PI planning and executive briefings.
* Expertise in both Scrum and Kanban frameworks.
* Proven experience managing dependencies and coordination among multiple agile teams.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build collaborative relationships across teams and stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* SAFe Scrum Master certification or equivalent Agile certifications.
* Experience working in large\-scale, multi\-team Agile organizations.
* Advanced degree in Business, Technology, or related discipline.
* Familiarity with agile project management tools such as Jira, Rally, or equivalent.

They observe team performance, identify bottlenecks, and drive continuous improvement practices while instilling the behaviors, mindsets, and characteristic of high\-performing organizations.
* They work closely with Product and Engineering leadership to ensure strategic alignment to organizational goals, consistent application of Agile principles, and the adoption of measurable practices such as flow metrics, operational KPIs, backlog quality standards, and regular inspection/adaptation cadences, all underpinned by rigorous Jira hygiene, structured data taxonomies, and analytics\-ready configurations.
* The Agile Coach also plays a critical role in organizational change management, helping teams navigate new processes, structural shifts, evolving business strategies, and the organizational adoption of AI across the product development lifecycle. They ensure that improvements across workflows, practices, and interpersonal behaviors translate into meaningful client outcomes and sustained organizational success.


 What You’ll Be Doing:
   

  

* Serve as a visible, motivational leader who reinforces a culture where every contributor understands how their work drives measurable client outcomes, market impact, and organizational performance
* Model excellence in agile ceremonies and organizational alignment by grounding teams in client value streams, end\-to\-end product flow, and operational improvements tied to strategic objectives
* Coach and mentor Product Owners, Product Managers, product development teams, and engineering leaders to strengthen delivery impact, economic prioritization, and predictable execution aligned to product purpose and business strategy
* Architect and operationalize enterprise\-wide performance visibility through disciplined, expert\-level use of Jira and it Jira Query Language (JQL), including project structures, issue type hierarchies, custom fields, workflow design, board configurations, automation rules, and advanced JQL to establish standardized definitions, workflows, reporting structures, and data integrity that enable comparable, decision\-ready insights across all product lines
* Own the Jira data model as a strategic asset: design and enforce taxonomies, field conventions, and workflow states that produce clean, analytics\-ready datasets with governed quality standards across Jira and analytical tooling such as Pendo and internal reporting platforms
* Unify diverse product offerings into a cohesive operational system by connecting Jira structures, analytical tooling, and reporting into a single source of truth \- enabling leadership to evaluate performance holistically, allocate capital with clarity, and trust the data behind every decision


 What You Need:
   

  

* BA/BS in computer science, economics, product development, or a related field
* 5\+ years of experience coaching Agile product teams or operating in a Product Owner, Product Manager, Scrum Master, or Agile leadership role within a modern product organization
* Proven ability to apply the Theory of Constraints in real\-world product environments \- removing bottlenecks, optimizing the order of operations, and reducing opportunity and input costs to accelerate value delivery and improve ROI.
* Hands\-on proficiency with product and operational tooling (i.e., Jira, Pendo, analytics dashboards) and the ability to leverage these tools to surface insights, guide decisions, and improve team performance
* Exceptional communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complexity, influence cross\-functional stakeholders, and drive alignment from teams through executive leadership
* A data\-informed, product\-thinking mindset with the ability to diagnose delivery friction, interpret team and product KPIs, and coach teams toward measurable improvements in customer and business outcomes
* A modern coaching approach, empathetic, pragmatic, outcomes\-driven, and grounded in enabling teams to build the right things, the right way, at the right time


 The Brightly culture
   

  

 We’re guided by a vision of community that serves the ambitions and wellbeing of all people, and our professional communities are no exception. We model that ideal every day by being supportive, collaborative partners to one another, conscientiously making space for our colleagues to grow and thrive. Our passionate team is driven to create a future where smarter infrastructure protects the environments that shape and connect us all. That brighter future starts with us.

Operating from our secure onsite facility in Chennai, you will take ownership of advanced contract extraction, lead Quality Control (QC) processes, and drive team success.

* Perform meticulous Quality Control (QC) checks on data fields, document reviews, contract abstracts, and redactions processed by junior team members to ensure alignment with client requirements and quality targets.

* Design, implement, and lead structured on\-the\-job training programs for entry\-level freshers and new hires on the abstraction and eDiscovery workflows.
* Mentor junior team members through regular feedback loops, helping them understand complex commercial boilerplate provisions and improve their speed and accuracy.
* Lead daily team huddles, calibration sessions, and knowledge\-sharing meetings to align interpretation standards across the production floor and meet strict delivery deadlines.

**Description**


IFC — a member of the World Bank Group — is the largest global development institution focused on the private sector in emerging markets. We work in more than 100 countries, using our capital, expertise, and influence to create markets and opportunities in developing countries. In fiscal year 2025, IFC committed a record $71 billion to private companies and financial institutions in developing countries, leveraging private sector solutions, and mobilizing private capital to create a world free of poverty on a livable planet. For more information, visit www.ifc.org.


IFC is seeking a Regional Industry Manager for its Financial Institutions Group (FIG) investment activities in Cambodia, Indonesia, Laos, Malaysia, Myanmar, Singapore, Timor Leste and the Pacific Islands. The position is based in Jakarta and will report to the Regional Industry Director, FIG Asia Pacific (CF4\).


The Regional Industry Manager will be responsible for leading business development, transaction processing, and portfolio management for FIG investment activities in the region. She/he will also coordinate on a continuous basis with IFC’s Regional Directors, Country Managers, the Asia Pacific FIG Leadership Team, World Bank Group (WBG) Knowledge Bank Financial Services Sector (FSS) and other Regional Managers, as well as other relevant departments/divisions within IFC, such as Special Operations (CSO), Treasury, Legal, Risk, the Equity Desk, Environmental \& Social, etc.

**Duties and Accountabilities*** Develop the strategy for IFC’s FIG in the region, in partnership with the regional and industry management and relevant WBG colleagues, including key business goals for the FIG regional investment program, with a focus on high impact projects and in line with WBG Country Partnership Frameworks.
* Coordinate with the Upstream and Advisory services teams in implementing the FIG strategy for Asia Pacific.
* Build and maintain high\-level relationships with clients in the region, understand sector trends, lead multidisciplinary teams to turn leads into deals that effectively balance IFC’s additionality, sustainable development impact, opportunity for innovation as well as scalability, and financial risks and rewards.
* Lead FIG business development efforts in the sub\-region, together with the regional/country teams and WBG Knowledge Bank FSS teams, ensuring high level of client satisfaction and program delivery within impact and profitability targets.
* Actively manage profitability for the FIG business in the sub\-region, with strong revenue and net income generation for long\-term financial sustainability.
* Assume the Transaction Manager role and provide operational guidance to teams ensuring rigorous quality control on teams’ output.
* Work with Regional Industry Managers in the Infrastructure and Natural Resources (INR) and Manufacturing‚ Agribusiness, and Services (MAS) departments to explore areas of joint ventures to expand IFC’s business.
* Foster relationships with WBG counterparts to identify collaboration opportunities and to enhance business delivery at the country and regional levels.
* Ensure portfolio experience and perspective is fed into strategy development and business decision making, through sharing of lessons learned from the portfolio, producing benchmarking analytics, etc.
* Report on the profitability and development impact of the portfolio and actively seek ways to optimize usage of economic capital and profitability performance, through sales, risk sharing or mobilization.
* Monitor the overall risk of the debt portfolio, ensure reviews of all active projects are completed on time and to the highest quality standard, and make recommendations on the appropriate level of specific loan loss reserves.
* Actively manage the entire equity portfolio, both core and non\-core, ensuring equity management plans are developed and adhered to for all assets, including proposing and filling board seats with qualified candidates for strategic assets.
* Regularly review valuations, write\-downs, exit strategies of the equity book, and develop a plan to sell less strategic assets to free up resources.
* Provide early warning for assets at risk and actively communicate with relevant colleagues regarding both debt and equity watch lists, ensuring close coordination with CSO and other Risk counterparts on rescheduling and restructuring situations.
* Supervise compliance with IFC financial, environmental, legal, and other requirements.
* Lead and manage the unit and ensure the team is high\-performing, well\-motivated, and committed to the advancement of IFC’s strategic goals.
* Be part of, and actively contribute to, the regional leadership team and the WBG Knowledge Bank FSS teams.
* Mentor and develop FIG staff in the sub\-region.
* Provide the full range of administrative and HR Management oversight.

**Selection Criteria**

* Master's degree in business, finance or equivalent qualification.
* Minimum 12 years of relevant experience in the financial sector.
* Strong sense of service to clients, with strong track record in developing client relationships and processing quality investments.
* Deep knowledge of capital markets.
* Proven experience sourcing and structuring complex investment transactions.
* Demonstrated ability to think strategically, develop innovative solutions, challenge the status quo, and make sound decisions to build IFC business.
* Sound knowledge of portfolio/asset management and experience in portfolio supervision of loans, equities and guarantees, and restructurings and recovery of impaired assets.
* Ability to work in the matrix as an integral part of the Regional Department, delivering high quality work within tight deadlines and meeting team objectives.
* Proven experience in managing and developing teams.
* Strong written and verbal communications skills.
* Meet the World Bank Group\-wide managerial competencies: Courage of your Convictions, Leading the Team for Impact, Influencing Across Boundaries, Fostering Openness to New Ideas, Building Talent for the Future.

**WBG Culture Attributes:**


1\. Sense of urgency: Anticipate and quickly respond to the needs of internal and external stakeholders.  

2\. Thoughtful risk\-taking: Challenge the status quo and push boundaries to achieve greater impact.
  

3\. Empowerment and accountability: Empower yourself and others to act and hold each other accountable for results.


World Bank Group Core Competencies

title: Director - Threat Management
description:
Overview:
**Job Purpose**


At StoneX, Threat Management is more than monitoring alerts and responding to incidents—it’s about building the capabilities, teams, and intelligence that allow the business to operate confidently in an evolving threat landscape. As the **Director of Threat Management**, you’ll lead the strategy and execution behind our global Threat Management organization, including the Security Operations Center (SOC), Threat Detection \& Applied Intelligence (TDAI), Exposure Management (Vulnerability Management and Threat Intelligence), and Insider Risk.


Your mission is to shape the future of how StoneX detects, responds to, and reduces cyber risk at scale. You’ll lead through transformation—modernizing operations, driving AI and automation adoption, strengthening detection and response capabilities, and developing resilient teams that can adapt to rapidly changing threats.

**This****isn’t****a role for managing alerts or operating tools directly—****it’s****a role for leading people, setting vision, and driving operational maturity through empowered teams and leaders.**You’ll partner with technology, infrastructure, legal, HR, compliance, and business leadership to ensure Threat Management remains aligned to business priorities while enabling the organization to move quickly and securely.


On **Day 1**, you’ll step into leadership of an experienced and globally distributed Threat Management organization. **Your****priority****will be to listen and learn**—understanding the people, operational rhythms, team dynamics, current capabilities, and areas of opportunity across SOC operations, detection engineering, exposure management, and insider risk. You’ll spend time building trust with managers, technical leaders, and key stakeholders while assessing the current state of operations, tooling, processes, and strategic priorities. Success in this role starts with partnership, thoughtful leadership, and clarity of direction—not sweeping change for the sake of change.


Responsibilities:
**As the Director of Threat Management, responsibilities****include:**

* **Strategic Leadership:** Define and execute the long\-term Threat Management strategy and roadmap aligned to enterprise risk priorities, evolving threats, and business objectives.
* **Operational Excellence:**Lead and mature global Threat Management operations, including SOC, incident response, detection engineering, exposure management, insider risk, and threat intelligence capabilities.
* **Transformation \& Innovation:**Drive modernization initiatives focused on AI, automation, detection engineering, threat hunting, and scalable security operations.
* **Culture:** Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, inclusion, innovation, and continuous learning across global teams.
* **Building Leaders:**Develop managers and technical leaders into strong, empowered leaders capable of building high\-performing global teams.
* **Driving Outcomes:**Establish measurable operational goals, maturity metrics, KRIs, and KCIs while ensuring accountability and continuous improvement across teams.
* **Executive Partnership:**Serve as a trusted advisor to executives and business leaders by translating cyber risk into meaningful business impact and operational readiness insights.
* **Financial Stewardship:**Support budget planning, vendor strategy, and investment prioritization to ensure Threat Management capabilities scale effectively and sustainably.

**As the Director of Threat Management, a typical week****might include the following:**

* Spending at least four days in the office engaging directly with leaders, analysts, engineers, and stakeholders to drive alignment and operational momentum.
* Meeting with managers and technical leaders to review incidents, operational performance, staffing needs, roadmap progress, and strategic initiatives.
* Partnering with infrastructure, engineering, legal, HR, compliance, and business leadership to coordinate priorities and improve enterprise\-wide security readiness.
* Reviewing major incidents, emerging threats, geopolitical risks, and operational trends while helping teams navigate high\-pressure situations effectively.
* Coaching leaders in communication, decision\-making, operational maturity, and team development strategies.
* Driving discussions around automation, AI capabilities, threat detection improvements, and long\-term operational transformation initiatives.
* Participating in executive and cross\-functional meetings to communicate risk, operational readiness, and Threat Management priorities.
* Reviewing vendor strategy, technology investments, staffing models, and budget priorities to ensure alignment with long\-term operational goals.

**This job might be for you if:**

* You’re **culture\-driven** – you believe strong security teams are built through inclusion, mentorship, accountability, and continuous learning.
* You’re **collaborative**– you know the best security outcomes come from strong partnerships across business and technology teams.
* You’re **calm under pressure** – during incidents or crisis situations, people look to you for clarity, direction, and steady leadership.
* You’re **approachable**– whether working with analysts, engineers, executives, or business stakeholders, people trust your authenticity and communication style.
* You’re **operationally minded** – you thrive in fast\-moving environments and can balance strategic thinking with strong operational execution.
* You’re a **leader of leaders** – you enjoy building managers and technical leaders into confident, capable leaders who empower their teams to succeed.
* You’re **transformation\-focused** – you’re energized by modernizing security operations through AI, automation, and scalable processes.
* You’re **strategically curious** – you think beyond today’s threats and focus on how to evolve organizations for the future.


Qualifications:
**To land this role:**

**Required qualifications:**

* 12\+ years of experience across cybersecurity and related enterprise technology domains.
* 7\+ years of experience leading global security operations, Threat Management, or related security functions.
* Demonstrated leadership experience across one or more of the following areas: SOC operations, incident response, detection engineering, threat intelligence, exposure management, insider risk, or security automation.
* Experience leading operational transformation initiatives focused on modernization, scalability, automation, or AI adoption.
* Strong understanding of cloud security, endpoint security, identity security, networking, and enterprise infrastructure environments.
* Experience managing high\-pressure operational environments, crisis response, and enterprise\-wide incident coordination.
* Proven ability to influence executives, communicate risk effectively, and lead cross\-functional initiatives.
* Experience building strategic roadmaps, operational maturity programs, and measurable performance outcomes.
* Experience leading and developing geographically distributed teams.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in information security, Computer Science, Engineering, or related fields. Equivalent experience and non\-traditional paths are welcomed.
* Industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, GIAC, GCIA, GCIH, or related security certifications.
* Experience within highly regulated industries and/or financial services environments.
* Experience implementing AI\-driven security operations or advanced automation capabilities within Threat Management programs.
* Experience representing organizations externally through industry engagement, conferences, or thought leadership initiatives.

title: Revenue Cycle Management Manager
description:
**Who We Are**

Proficio Therapy Services is a mission driven therapy organization dedicated to improving the lives of children and families. We provide high quality ABA Therapy, Speech Therapy, and Occupational Therapy through our family of licensed clinical entities:

* **AGES Learning Solutions LLC** – ABA Therapy
* **Proficio Speech Therapy Group Inc** – Speech Therapy
* **Child’s Play Therapy Services PC** – Occupational Therapy

Today, we operate **11 clinics across the United States**, supported by more than 250 clinicians. We are actively expanding into **additional cities throughout California and Utah**, with international growth underway in India and the Middle East.

Our teams are backed by strong clinical leadership, reliable operational systems, and a culture built on respect, inclusion, and collaboration. Whether you’re starting your career or stepping into leadership, you’ll find opportunities to grow, contribute, and make a meaningful impact every day.

At Proficio, your work truly matters and so does your growth. Join us as we continue building a unified, global therapy organization dedicated to empowering children and families.

**Job Summary/Overview:**

The **Manager – Revenue Cycle Management**  is responsible for managing end\-to\-end medical billing and revenue cycle operations for Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA**)** services. This role ensures accurate and compliant billing, timely reimbursement, effective denial management, and optimization of revenue cycle performance while leading billing teams and collaborating with clinical, authorization, scheduling, finance, and operations stakeholders.

**Reporting Structure:**

Reports to Vice President

**Responsibilities and Duties:**

* Manage day\-to\-day ABA medical billing and revenue cycle operations, including charge entry, claims submission, payment posting, accounts receivable follow\-up, underpayment recovery, and denial management.
* Ensure timely, accurate, and compliant submission of claims by implementing standardized workflows, payer\-specific guidelines, and quality control measures.
* Monitor and improve key revenue cycle metrics, including Days in AR, AR Aging, Clean Claim Rate, First Pass Resolution Rate, Collection Ratio, Denial Rate, and Write\-off trends, and provide regular reports to leadership.
* Identify revenue leakage, billing discrepancies, authorization gaps, coding issues, and payer\-related risks, and implement corrective actions to improve revenue realization.
* Collaborate closely with clinical, authorization, scheduling, compliance, finance, and operations teams to ensure seamless billing processes and timely issue resolution.
* Support process improvement initiatives through workflow optimization, automation, SOP enhancements, and operational best practices.
* Lead, mentor, and supervise billing team leads and billing specialists while fostering a culture of accountability, quality, and continuous improvement.
* Establish team performance goals, monitor productivity and quality metrics, provide coaching, and support employee development.
* Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), workflows, escalation matrices, and process documentation to ensure consistency and compliance.
* Allocate workloads effectively across the billing team to ensure adherence to turnaround times, service level agreements (SLAs), and payer deadlines.
* Identify training needs and coordinate onboarding, cross\-training, and skill development initiatives for team members.
* Act as the primary escalation point for complex billing, accounts receivable, payer disputes, and reimbursement issues within the ABA billing function.
* Support hiring, workforce planning, and performance management activities in collaboration with leadership and HR.
* Analyze denial trends and implement corrective actions to reduce recurring denials and improve reimbursement rates.
* Maintain structured denial tracking, financial impact analysis, and appeal reporting to drive continuous improvement.
* Ensure compliance with HIPAA, CMS regulations, payer\-specific billing requirements, authorization guidelines, and documentation standards.
* Coordinate internal and external audits by maintaining accurate documentation and supporting timely resolution of audit findings.
* Oversee appeals for denied and underpaid claims to maximize reimbursement while ensuring adherence to payer timelines.
* Stay updated on payer policy changes, reimbursement guidelines, and industry best practices, implementing necessary operational updates and team training.
* Prepare operational MIS reports and dashboards highlighting billing performance, trends, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities.
* Support billing system enhancements, reporting improvements, automation initiatives, and process digitization projects.
* Coordinate with insurance payers, clearinghouses, and internal stakeholders to resolve billing issues efficiently while maintaining high service standards.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
* **6–8 years** of experience in Medical Billing and Revenue Cycle Management, including at least **2–3 years of team management or supervisory experience**.
* Strong expertise in end\-to\-end Revenue Cycle Management, including claims processing, accounts receivable management, denial management, appeals, and reimbursement optimization.
* Experience managing **ABA billing operations** with knowledge of authorization\-driven and time\-based billing models.
* Strong understanding of US healthcare regulations, including HIPAA, CMS guidelines, and commercial and government payer requirements.
* Demonstrated ability to improve key revenue cycle metrics such as Days in AR, denial rates, clean claim rates, and collections.
* Hands\-on experience with medical billing systems, clearinghouses, reporting tools, and revenue cycle automation initiatives.
* Strong leadership, people management, communication, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* Professional certifications such as CPC, CCS, CPB, CRCR, or equivalent Revenue Cycle credentials are preferred.
* Experience with reporting tools, automation platforms, and business intelligence tools such as Power BI is an advantage.
* Experience supporting multi\-location healthcare organizations or ABA providers is highly desirable.

**Work Schedule:**

* Full Time \- Work from Office (Kochi)
* Ability to collaborate with US\-based teams and accommodate operational requirements as needed.

**Work Environment:**

* Fast\-paced healthcare revenue cycle environment supporting ABA services.
* Regular collaboration with clinical, authorization, scheduling, finance, compliance, and operations teams.
* Leadership role requiring strategic planning, operational oversight, and cross\-functional coordination.

**Compensation \& Benefits:**

* Salary: 75,000 to 85,000/\-
* Annual Performance Bonus.
* Medical Insurance Coverage.
* Paid time off.
* Opportunity to lead and scale revenue cycle operations within a rapidly growing international healthcare organization.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

*Proficio Speech Therapy is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer committed to building a team that represents the racial, ethnic and linguistic needs of our clients.* 

*This position description intends to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to include all duties and responsibilities. Because of a need to remain responsive to the needs of our clients and operational needs, job description and responsibilities may be modified at any time.*

Pay: ₹75,000\.00 \- ₹85,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: HR Officer
description:
**RESPONSIBILITIES AND DELIVERABLES: (including approximate percentage effort)**

**Human Resources Operations \& Compliance (35%)**  

* Manage end\-to\-end employee lifecycle processes including onboarding, confirmation, transfers, promotions, and separations.
* Ensure HR policies, procedures, and practices are implemented consistently across the organization.
* Maintain employee records and personnel files in compliance with organizational standards and statutory requirements.
* Ensure timely completion of HR documentation, contracts, employment letters, amendments, and employee communications.
* Monitor compliance with statutory requirements, audits, and internal controls.
* Coordinate with external vendors, consultants, and service providers for HR\-related services.
* Support internal and external audits by providing accurate HR documentation and reports.
* Maintain confidentiality and security of employee information and HR records.
**Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning (20%)**  

* Coordinate and manage end\-to\-end recruitment processes for assigned positions.
* Partner with hiring managers to understand workforce needs and support manpower planning.
* Manage candidate sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offer management, and onboarding activities.
* Track recruitment metrics including time\-to\-fill, hiring costs, candidate pipeline, and onboarding effectiveness.
* Build and maintain talent pools for future organizational requirements.
**HR Systems, Payroll \& Benefits Administration (15%)**  

* Serve as the focal point for HRIS data management and employee records administration.
* Coordinate monthly payroll inputs and validate employee data for payroll processing.
* Administer employee benefits programs including insurance, wellness initiatives, leave management, and statutory benefits.
* Ensure timely updates of employee data in local and global HR systems.
* Generate HR dashboards and reports related to headcount, attrition, recruitment, leave utilization, and workforce demographics.
**Employee Relations \& Engagement (15%)**  

* Act as a trusted point of contact for employee inquiries regarding policies, benefits, and HR processes.
* Plan and execute employee engagement initiatives, wellness programs, recognition activities, and organizational events.
* Promote a positive workplace culture aligned with organizational values.
**Performance Management \& Learning (10%)**  

* Support implementation of performance management processes including goal setting, reviews, and development planning.
* Coordinate training programs, learning initiatives, and capacity\-building activities.
* Track learning participation and maintain training records.
* Support succession planning and employee development initiatives.
**May perform other job\-related duties as assigned (5%)**

 **QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, or related field. Postgraduate qualification or certification in Human Resources Management preferred.
* 4\-6 years of progressive HR experience with significant exposure to HR operations, employee lifecycle management, recruitment, compliance, and employee relations..
* Knowledge of the NGO business sector; Knowledge of institutional funders for international development, a plus.
* Basic understanding of HR best practices, employment law, and regulatory requirements.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and experience with HRIS or payroll systems is a plus.
* Practical knowledge of the local country generally accepted accounting principles and fiscal statutes.
* Experience with accounting systems

description:
The Colleague Experience Group (CEG), formerly known as Human Resources, seeks to provide a great colleague experience every day. The Global Talent Acquisition function is going through a strategic recruitment transformation, deploying robotics \& process automation tools and modernizing recruitment infrastructure to focus on talent priorities and improve end\-to\-end process experience.


Talent Acquisition \& Onboarding is looking for a Talent Acquisition Partner to join our team, and lead recruiting priorities and end to end recruitment service delivery. The Talent Acquisition Partner will be responsible for executing the end\-to\-end hiring process, while ensuring outstanding Candidate and Hiring Leader experience. They will source, screen, assess, interview, and lead the offer process in order to acquire the best quality candidates effectively and efficiently. They will ensure the team is efficiently presenting high quality candidates. They will be talent champion who can actively stay connected to pipeline of candidates, maintain long\-term candidate relationships, and energetically discuss the career opportunities within American Express.


  
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent
* 5\+ years of recruitment experience in fast paced global recruitment environment
* Prior experience in developing and maintaining positive relationships with key partners, hiring managers including HR contact
* Experience in ATS and other new world recruitment tools, technologies and platforms to improve process efficiencies
* Outstanding assessment and interviewing skills; strong command of assessment and selection methodologies, instruments, and processes
* In\-depth knowledge of the recruiting landscape with ability to produce external trends, market intelligence and industry insights
* Proven ability to listen, understand, convey, and relate ideas, concepts and issues clearly and confidently through all channels while having an awareness of environmental cues.
* Worked in a team environment that emphasized group contributions
* Ability to build and sustain trust while demonstrating partnerships across levels.
* Ability to complete multiple projects/tasks at the same time under strict timelines
* Ability to interact with people at all levels of an organization and to develop strong business relationships

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Ability to interact with people across levels, collaborate and develop strong working relationships
* Experience in new world recruitment tools, technologies, and platforms to improve process efficiencies
* In\-depth knowledge of the recruiting landscape with ability to produce external trends, market intelligence and industry insights
* Demonstrated ability to listen, understand, convey, and relate ideas, concepts and issues clearly and confidently through all channels while having an awareness of environmental cues.
* Ability to build and sustain trust while leveraging partnerships at all levels
* Excellent communication, collaboration, influencing, and problem\-solving skills
* Successful track record of leading large\-scale initiatives
