title: Research Associate: Search & Advisory Services
description:
We are a search and advisory firm that specialises in the art and science of building collective leadership. Meraki, the Greek idea of leaving a part of yourself in what you create, is how we approach every mandate: with care and intent, sound judgment, and the discipline of putting heart and craft into purposeful work.
 



  





 Between our partners we hold 60\+ years of experience, work with 30\+ active clients across India and the GCC, and have made 100\+ appointments in the last three years. Nearly 90% of our work comes through referral. Every search is partner\-led, and we believe human insight and analytical precision belong together, not in opposition.
 



  





**About the role** 




  





 The Research Analyst is where many of our searches begin. It is an early\-career role for someone who wants to learn this craft properly, from understanding a market to helping a leader settle into a new home. You will sit close to the work and close to the partners, and grow by doing.
 



 Day to day, you will research markets and map talent, open and hold first conversations with prospective candidates, coordinate interviews, and prepare assessment reports alongside the Managing Partners. 
 



  





 You will also stay with a candidate through their offer and joining, so the move feels considered and well supported. The work asks for analytical rigour and genuine human sensitivity in equal measure.
 



 This is a role you are coached in, not left to figure out alone. You will work directly with the Managing Partners, who will help you build judgment and confidence over time. Based at our Chennai office in Old Mahabalipuram Road.
 



  





**Experience required** 




  





 This is a fresher role, open to anyone at the start of their career. What matters is the way you think, the way you carry a conversation, and your appetite to learn the craft. We will teach you the rest.
 



  





**Who you'll work with** 




  




* Managing Partners, your reporting line and the people who coach you
* Candidates, the leaders you engage, assess, and support through the search process
* Your colleagues you learn alongside across live mandates



  





**What you'll learn** 




  




* The real reward here is the head start. In your first years you will learn the craft of partner\-led executive search from people who do it well.
* You will develop an eye for leadership across capability, context, and character, learn to pair analytical insight with human judgment in the Meraki way, and build the confidence to engage and support senior leaders with care. Few early roles offer this kind of exposure.



  





  





**What you'll earn** 




  




* Alongside the experience, the role carries a fair and competitive package for someone beginning their career, set in line with prevailing industry benchmarks for the stage and the role.
* We are happy to discuss specifics with you directly.



  





**How we show up to work** 




  




* Curious, and genuinely interested what makes leaders effective
* Dependable, accurate, and steady across many moving pieces
* Collaborative, supporting the team and learning openly from feedback
* In it for the long run, wanting to build a career here, not just hold a role



  





**Non Negotiable** 




  





 So much of this work is the conversation itself. From the first call, a candidate should feel they are speaking with someone credible, whether that person is a CEO, a plant head, or a founder building their first team.
 



  




* Flawless spoken and written English. Clear, precise, and assured in every call, email, and note; the language that represents Meraki People to senior leaders
* Ease across seniority. As comfortable with a CXO as with a mid\-management leader, adapting tone without losing warmth or authority
* Range across domains. Quick to pick up the language of an unfamiliar sector, enough to ask good questions and earn a leader's trust early in a conversation
* Presence on the call. Composed and convincing from the first line, the standard the best global search firms hold their incoming talent to

title: System Administrator
description:
**About CynLr** 




  





 Just like a baby’s brain, CynLr Visual Intelligence stack makes Robots to
 **instinctively see \& pick any object under any ambience, without any training. Demo Video** 




 Today, a robot that can fit a screw into a nut without slipping a thread, doesn’t exist. Imagine what it would take for a robot to
 **assemble a Smartphone** 
 or a car by putting together 1000s of parts with varied shapes and weights, all in random orientations. Thus, factories become complex, needing heavy customization of their environment.
 



 CynLr\-enabled visual robots intuitively learn to handle even unknown objects, on\-the\-fly, eliminating the need for rigid fixtures, pre\-training, or environment customization. This enables an universal alternative to custom automation thus simplifying factory lines into modular LEGO\-like micro\-factories that can be rapidly reconfigured as products change.
 



 At the core of CynLr lies a fundamentally new approach to machine vision. Unlike conventional vision systems that rely on image recognition and heuristics, CynLr’ s Vision and ML stacks are deeply inspired by neuroscience, modelling how biological vision understands shape, geometry, and interaction rather than appearance alone. To support this, CynLr builds its hardware, sensors, compute pipelines, and learning stacks from scratch, tightly coupling perception, decision\-making, and action.
 



 This integration allows CynLr to operate in conditions that defeat traditional automation: variable lighting, cluttered environments, unknown objects, and high precision manipulation, unlocking automation use cases that have remained unsolved for decades. By rethinking vision as an intelligent, adaptive sense rather than a static tool, CynLr is redefining how robots perceive, reason, and interact with the physical world.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




  





 As a
 *System Administrator at CynLr* 
 , you will design, build, and evolve IT infrastructure, processes, and practices that support research, product development, and operations, while ensuring efficient, secure, and sustainable usage. Process for the sake of process will not be entertained;
 *utility and convenience take precedence, and every system must justify its existence by improving real outcomes.* 





  





 CynLr's ambition demands not only breakthrough algorithms and hardware, but also a
 *robust, adaptive, and human\-centric IT infrastructure* 
 that allows teams to operate with minimal friction and maximum focus. As CynLr scales across disciplines, tools, and geographies,
 *IT infrastructure becomes the information backbone of the organization.* 
 The goal of this role is not merely uptime or compliance, but to
 *augment human productivity* 
 , eliminate hidden delays and context\-switching costs, and ensure that technology remains an enabler rather than a constraint.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





***A. Operate***




  




* Run and maintain IT infrastructure supporting research, engineering, and operations at scale.

* Manage network infrastructure including routers, switches, firewalls, Wi\-Fi, and VPNs.
* Perform hands\-on monitoring, troubleshooting, and incident resolution across hardware, OS, network, and applications.



  





***B. Build***




  




* Design and deploy Azure AD, Intune, and SharePoint policies for secure and organized access.
* Set up and maintain hardware infrastructure—laptops, workstations, servers, networking, and conferencing systems.
* Configure and support Windows Server, Linux, virtualization platforms (VMware / Hyper\-V).
* Establish remote workflows and inter\-office connectivity to enable distributed teams.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with hardware, software, and service vendors.



  





***C. Improve***



* Automate workflows and remediation using PowerShell scripting to reduce manual effort.
* Evaluate and select hardware and software based on supportability, ecosystem maturity, scalability, and lifecycle cost.
* Proactively monitor systems, analyse failures, and implement preventive and reliability improvements.
* Continuously refine IT processes and practices to remove friction and improve user productivity.



  





**Team Structure:** 



* The Operations team at CynLr functions as a
 *cross\-functional enablement layer* 
 that supports Engineering, Product, and Business teams in executing reliably and at scale. Within this structure, Technology and Systems responsibilities are owned as a core operational capability, ensuring that digital infrastructure, tools, and access evolve in step with how the organization works.
* Systems and IT operations are designed to be
 *deeply integrated into day\-to\-day execution* 
 , preserving context across teams and workflows. The function works closely with Engineering to support research and development needs, and with Operations and Finance to ensure reliability, security, and long\-term sustainability.



  





**What You’ll Need to Do This Well** 



* Strong understanding of computer hardware and workstations: CPU, memory, storage, BIOS/firmware and
 *how configuration choices impact developer productivity and system reliability.*
* Deep familiarity with
 *office productivity and collaboration systems,* 
 and the ability to
 *design workflows that reduce friction and context switching* 
 rather than add process overhead.
* Solid grounding in
 *networking fundamentals* 
 (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, firewalls) relevant to office, lab, and inter\-office environments.
* Clear understanding of
 *device configuration, identity management, and user access policies, balancing usability with security.*
* Working knowledge of
 *security principles, data protection, and basic database concepts,* 
 sufficient to design safe and scalable internal systems.



  





**Experience That Will Accelerate You** 



* Hands\-on experience with
 *DevOps or internal tooling infrastructure* 
 , especially in environments where tooling is still evolving.
* Experience setting up and maintaining databases or data services used internally by teams.
* Exposure to building IT systems in
 *fast\-moving, resource\-constrained environments where requirements change frequently.*
* *Experience supporting engineering\-heavy teams* 
 , including compute\-intensive workflows, development environments, and high\-performance workstations



  





**What will you do?** 



* You will design and operate the
 *digital infrastructure that enables CynLr’s teams to work without friction* 
 . Your role is to ensure that systems, tools, and access models support how people actually work across research, engineering, operations, and business functions.

 *translate organizational needs into reliable, secure, and intuitive IT systems, spanning devices, networks, collaboration tools, identity, and internal workflows* 
 . From onboarding a new team member to supporting compute\-heavy engineering setups, your work ensures that infrastructure never becomes the bottleneck to progress.

 , suited to a deep\-tech environment where requirements evolve rapidly and standard enterprise playbooks often fall short.

title: Network Engineer, Capacity Restoration Team
description:
**Description**
 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 As a Network Engineer on CRT, you execute capacity restoration workflows across Amazon’s global network. You troubleshoot link and device failures. You coordinate with cross\-functional teams. You drive TTR down for out\-of\-service capacity. This role is focused on operational execution using existing tools and processes. You work at the component level, solving straightforward problems with guidance from your team.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Execute link restoration workflows for Regional Border and Backbone spans.
* Troubleshoot hardware and software failures on network devices.
* Coordinate with carriers, colocation providers, and data center technicians on repairs.
* Monitor capacity health using operational event monitoring systems, network health monitoring systems, and workflow orchestration engines.
* Perform device health checks and link tests to validate restoration.
* Maintain accurate records of restoration progress, backlog status, and TTR metrics.
* Identify patterns in recurring failures and escalate to engineering teams.
* Contribute to operational runbooks and process documentation.
* Participate in on\-call rotations for follow\-the\-sun coverage.


 A day in the life
   

  

* Monitor capacity health dashboards and respond to out\-of\-service alerts
* Troubleshoot hardware/software failures on backbone and border network devices
* Execute restoration workflows using established automation and runbooks
* Coordinate with carriers, colocation providers, and data center technicians on link repairs
* Document incidents and contribute to post\-event reviews
* Participate in on\-call rotations supporting high severity calls and operational events.


**About The Team**
 The Capacity Restoration Team (CRT) sits within Backbone, Enterprise, Regional Engineering (BERE) organization. Our mission is to own end\-to\-end restoration of out\-of\-service inter\-metro and intra\-metro network capacity.
   

  

 CRT reduces operational backlog, improves network health monitoring systems, and drives time\-to\-remediate (TTR) down. Today, a significant network capacity is out of service at any given time. The operational workload is capacity related and heavily manual and we are building the team and automation to change that.
   

  

 We operate across Seattle, Dublin, Hyderabad, and Sydney for follow\-the\-sun coverage. CRT acts as the connective layer between Engineering, Operations, Tooling, and Software teams.
   

  

**About Aws**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, electrical engineering, or related field
* Experience with IP networking fundamentals and TCP/IP, UDP, DNS \& DHCP
* Experience in Linux OS and network troubleshooting, or experience with network troubleshooting tools (telnet, test\-netconnection, tracert, tracetcp, iperf, ntttcp, dig, and packet capture tools)
* Experience working in a Linux/Unix environment
* 3\+ years of experience in network operations or network engineering.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in major internet routing protocols, specifically BGP and OSPF
* Experience in managing and troublshooting network, or experience in technical support and experience in networking administration and troubleshooting
* 3\+ years of work in large\-scale networking environments experience
* 1\+ years of computer hardware troubleshooting and repair experience, or experience with cabling infrastructure best practices and methodologies
* Knowledge of network cabling, optic types, and test equipment
* Experience with mission\-critical, 24x7 operations
* CCNA or equivalent level networking certification

 instructions, and other materials. This role requires close collaboration with representatives from operations, laboratories, and maintenance groups across various DM\&C assets. Additionally, the Technical Writer works alongside engineering professionals on technical projects, as well as ENGINE technical personnel, to ensure all DM\&C procedures are administered in alignment with enterprise and DM\&C standards for Operating Procedures. Job Title
   

  

 Technical Writer 50
   

  

**Job Description**
**Technical Writer**
 You will be responsible for creating detailed and comprehensive technical documentation, including user manuals, installation guides, and product specifications, working under direct supervision. The role works closely with engineering, product management, and design teams to translate complex technical concepts into clear, user\-friendly content. The role involves conducting in\-depth research to ensure all documentation is accurate and up to date, as well as implementing industry best practices to enhance quality.
   

  

**Your Role**
* Develop detailed and comprehensive technical documentation, including user manuals, installation guides, and product specifications, ensuring accuracy and clarity across all materials, working under direct supervision.
* Collaborate extensively with engineering, product management, and design teams to translate complex technical concepts into clear, concise, and user\-friendly documentation.
* Conduct in\-depth research to understand the functionality, features, and technical aspects of products, ensuring that all documentation is based on accurate and up\-to\-date information.
* Implement best practices in technical writing, incorporating industry standards and organizational protocols to enhance the quality and effectiveness of documentation.
* Analyze feedback from users and stakeholders to continuously improve the clarity, usability, and accessibility of technical documentation.
* Coordinate with subject matter experts to validate and verify technical content, ensuring the accuracy and relevance of all documentation.
* Maintain and update existing documentation in line with product updates, ensuring that all materials reflect the latest features, functionalities, and technical specifications.
* Ensure that all technical documentation is consistent with brand guidelines, organizational tone, and style, while also meeting regulatory and compliance requirements.
* Optimize documentation processes by identifying inefficiencies and recommending improvements that enhance productivity and quality.
* Troubleshoot and swiftly resolve any documentation\-related issues or discrepancies, ensuring minimal disruption to project timelines and deliverables.
* Specialize in a particular area of the product or technology, becoming the go\-to expert for technical documentation related to that area and providing specialized content as needed.


**You Are Fit If**
* You have bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or SW Engineering or equivalent.
* You have minimum 2 years of experience in Technical Writing
* Your skills include attention to detail, analytical thinking, problem solving
* You are a self\-starter with the ability and desire to continuously learn.
* You have structured authoring experience with any of the XML/DITA\-based Content Management Systems (CMS) such as Arbortext on Windchill, or any other editor.
* You have good skills in the areas of writing and are conversant in English grammar \& Technical Writing
* You have a strong command of the English language with excellent communication skills.
* Broad technical knowledge of medical devices/products is a plus

 Onsite roles require full\-time presence in the company’s facilities.
   

  

 Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.
   

  

 This role is an office\-based role.

 We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help the lives of others.

description:
**ABOUT AGRATAS** 




 Agratas is a wholly owned subsidiary of Tata Sons. We design, develop and manufacture high\-quality, high\-performance, sustainable batteries applied to multiple use cases in the mobility and energy sectors, to match our customers’ requirements.
 



 Agratas is a scale\-up business with a start\-up mentality, driven by our pursuit of green growth and technological progress.
 



 We develop next\-generation battery technologies at our state\-of\-the\-art R\&D Innovation Hubs in India and the UK.
 



  





**JOB SUMMARY** 




 We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Manufacturing \-Technical Writer specializes in creating and standardization of documentation, specifically for manufacturing processes, equipment, procedures, and safety protocols. They ensure that all manufacturing\-related information is clear, accurate, and accessible to various stakeholders like operators, engineers, and maintenance teams. Their role is crucial for ensuring consistency, efficiency, safety, and compliance in the cell manufacturing environment.
 



 Technical writer's role is to ensure that technical information is communicated effectively, accurately, and understandably to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
 



  





**RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  





**Develop \& Standardize Documentation of Manufacturing Processes** 



* Create Manuals, user guides, help files, release notes \& troubleshooting procedures for operators and technicians to resolve common issues during production or equipment malfunction. Compile frequently asked questions (FAQ) and common troubleshooting tips to assist workers in diagnosing problems without the need for expert assistance. Translation of technical language or if any other country language as required. (Process Documentation, Standard Operating Procedures, Work Instructions \& Process Flow Diagrams).
* Integrate diagrams, images, videos, and other visual aids to enhance understanding, particularly in explaining intricate manufacturing processes or machinery functions.



  





  




* Develop Safety guidelines \& Procedures – considering Plant standards as well Govt applicable compliances.
* Write and maintain documents required for regulatory compliance, such as those related to OSHA, ISO standards, other applicable Govt regulations, and industry\-specific guidelines for India \& UK Plants.
* Develop quality control documents, including inspection checklists, testing procedures, and documentation for compliance audits.
* Create \& Ensure that all documentation is version\-controlled and consistently updated to reflect any changes in the manufacturing processes or regulations and standardization.



  




* Evaluate current content and develop innovative methods for improvement.
* Break down complex technical concepts into simple, easy\-to\-understand language for non\-technical users.



**Collaboration with cross function team** 



* Work closely with Vendors, Line builders, subject matter experts (SMEs), engineers, developers, product managers, and other team members to gather information.
* Become familiar with the product, service, or system in question to ensure accurate and up\-to\-date documentation.
* Identify the target audience’s to write content that caters to their needs.
* Indentify new tools, equipment, or methods being introduced into manufacturing and create accurate and thorough documentation.
* Accuracy: A keen eye for detail is essential, as technical documentation often involves precise instructions and specifications. A small mistake in a manual could lead to equipment malfunctions, safety incidents, or inefficiencies in the manufacturing process.
* Consistency: Ensuring that the terminology, format, and style remain consistent across all documentation to reduce confusion and maintain professionalism.



  





  





**Knowledge, Skills and Experience** 




  




* 5 to 7 years of experience as technical writer in manufacturing industry – preferably in Cell manufacturing industry.
* Proven ability to quickly learn and understand complex subject matter \& Excellent in communication.
* Experience in managing cross\-functional teams and coordinating multiple stakeholders.
* Expertise in NLP APIs and use of following latest technology.




 Help Authoring Tools (HATs) \- Familiarity with tools like MadCap Flare, RoboHelp, or Doc\-To\-Help to create interactive documentation.
 



 Diagramming Tools \- Proficiency in tools like Microsoft Visio, Lucidchart, or Draw.io to create process diagrams, flowcharts, equipment layouts, and schematics.
 



 Graphic Tools \- Knowledge of image editing tools like Snagit and Adobe Photoshop to capture and annotate images or screenshots for instructional manuals.
 



 Content Management Systems (CMS)\- Experience with CMS tools like Confluence, SharePoint, or document repositories to organize and manage documentation, ensuring easy access and version control.
 



  





**Role Specific Qualifications/Certifications**




  





 Trained Technical writer \-Certification from STC / TWC or from any authorized institute
 



 Trained in Manufacturing Six Sigma \& ISO 9001 – preferred if any certification
 



 Document management systems certification from any authorized institute.

 Senior Technical Writer
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bengaluru \& Chennai, India
   

  

**Department:** 
 Technical Communication Center of Excellence
   

  

**Company:** 
 Xylem Water Solutions India Private Limited, Global Capability Center, Bangalore
   

  

**About Xylem**
 Xylem is a leading global water technology company committed to solving the world’s most challenging water issues through innovation. Our mission is to enable sustainable, efficient water use and management for communities, industries, and the environment.
   

  

**About The Position**
 As a Senior Technical Writer at Xylem, you will be part of the Global Technical Communication Center of Excellence, responsible for developing world\-class customer documentation (Hardware/Software). You will author and manage content within a Component Content Management System (CCMS), collaborating closely with Project Coordinators and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) globally. Your work will support customers of Xylem products and systems through clear, accurate, and user\-focused documentation such as Installation and Operation Instructions, Service Manuals, and other technical publications.
   

  

 As you grow in this role, you will have opportunities to contribute to continuous improvement projects, process optimization, and training initiatives within Xylem’s documentation ecosystem.
   

  

**About The Technical Communication Center Of Excellence**
 A global team of technical information specialists responsible for developing customer product information across Xylem’s product portfolio. The team focuses on intelligent content reuse using XML\-based technologies, ensuring all publications are customer\-centric, reusable, and globally consistent across multiple outputs, channels, and languages.
   

  

 Prominent collaterals include Installation and Operation Instructions, Datasheets, Quick Guides, UI Guides, and UX Guides, Technical specifications etc.
   

  

 The team consists of a Content Development (Production) Team, a Localization Team, and a Documentation Systems Team.
   

  

**About The Team In Bengaluru \& Chennai (GCC)**
 The Global Capability Center (GCC) in Bengaluru \& Chennai serves as a shared service; resources supporting Xylem’s global product portfolio — including pumps, turbines, monitoring and control systems, and water analysis equipment. The team contributes to product design, development, testing, and technical documentation to deliver innovative and reliable water technology solutions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Content Development
   

  

* Develop reusable, structured technical content aligned with Xylem’s authoring guidelines, information model, and style guide.
* Conduct task analysis (TA) and prepare annotated topic lists (ATL).
* Create and maintain Topics, Chaptermaps, Bookmaps, and metadata within the CCMS.
* Produce and maintain illustrations, graphics, and photo\-realistic renderings.
* Ensure the completion of review cycle and software\-assisted checks for grammar, style, and terminology.
* Initiate translation requests and coordinate translation reviews.
* Communicate release updates to stakeholders via designated channels.
* Contribute to the development of the CCMS structure, templates, and information model.
* Participate in initiatives to enhance documentation quality, workflow efficiency, and content governance.


**Required Qualifications**
 Education
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical, Electronics, Aeronautical, Computer Science, or equivalent field).


**Experience**
* 4–6 years of professional experience as a Technical Writer (Senior level) in an international, English\-language environment.
* Proven expertise in DITA XML authoring and single\-sourcing practices.
* Basic experience creating technical illustrations in vector or raster formats.


 Skills and Competencies
   

  

 Core Skills
   

  

* Excellent command of written and spoken English.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and documentation skills.
* Detail\-oriented, structured, and dependable on meeting deadlines.
* Effective communicator with global, cross\-functional teams.
* Familiarity with Simplified Technical English (STE) and style guides such as the Microsoft or Chicago Manual of Style.
* Understanding of DDLC, SDLC, and Agile workflows.
* Knowledge of single sourcing, metadata management, and conditional profiling.


 Technical Skills
   

  

* Proficiency in DITA XML and CCMS platforms such as Astoria On\-Demand or AEM.
* Skilled in XML editors such as Oxygen XML Editor or Arbortext Editor.
* Experience with terminology and content quality tools such as Acrolinx.
* Proficiency with illustration tools (Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Creo Illustrate, Keyshot).
* Experience with collaboration tools like JIRA and Confluence.

We use data to make decisions about our content, and we advocate for the investigator and customer experience while balancing advocacy with the need for action. title: Enterprise Implementation Consultant
description:
**Enterprise Implementation Consultant** 




 Delhi NCR · Mumbai · Bengaluru · Hyderabad · Pune (PAN INDIA) \| In\-Office \+ Client Site \| Enterprise SaaS \| Construction Tech
 



  





**About RDash** 




 Construction is a $13 trillion global industry — and one of the least digitised. Projects routinely overrun budgets and timelines because execution data lives in spreadsheets, WhatsApp groups, and the heads of site engineers. The cost of this opacity runs into millions on every project.
 



 RDash is an AI\-powered Construction Management System that gives construction and infrastructure companies real\-time control, visibility, and predictability over project execution.
 



**Credentials:** 



* Backed by Y Combinator, Stellaris Venture Partners \& Zacua Ventures
* RICS SEA PropTech of the Year — 2024 \& 2025, ET Realty PropTech of the Year 2024, 2026
* Reference Customers: Amazon (India \& UAE), JSW Homes, The Fitout, LivSpace, Semac Construction, Blinkit, Table Space, Fortes Education,



  





**The Role** 




 We are hiring Enterprise Implementation Consultants to serve as the primary client\-facing interface for RDash deployments at some of India’s most complex construction and infrastructure organisations.
 



**This is not a back\-office coordination role.** 




 You will be embedded on\-prem at enterprise client sites — operating inside organisations like Amazon, JSW, LivSpace, Blinkit, Table Space etc. Working under the direction of an experienced EIC Lead, your mandate is to translate client workflows into structured RDash implementations, drive user adoption from Day 1, and serve as the trusted consultant bridging client operations and the RDash product team.
 



 You will own on\-the\-ground execution: stakeholder engagement, training delivery, adoption tracking, process documentation, and continuous improvement — with direct support from a seasoned EIC Lead throughout.
 



  





**What You Will Own** 



* Client\-side implementation support — conducting workflow discovery sessions, mapping organisation structures, and assisting in configuring approval hierarchies and SOPs within RDash
* Stakeholder engagement across department heads and on\-ground teams — building credibility, facilitating alignment, and maintaining momentum across the deployment lifecycle
* Training programme delivery — executing department\-wise and role\-specific training sessions, producing structured training materials, and driving hands\-on adoption from Day 1
* Adoption monitoring and reporting — tracking usage dashboards, auditing system activity, producing weekly adoption reports, and escalating non\-compliance to the EIC Lead with clear documentation
* Process documentation — preparing MOMs, SOPs, training schedules, and audit reports that are acted upon by client stakeholders
* Data coordination — supporting the migration and structuring of client data including BOQs, vendor masters, and rate contracts into RDash
* Internal coordination — channelling client feedback and field observations to the EIC Lead and RDash product team with clarity and context
* Continuous improvement — identifying workflow gaps and proposing improvements that increase platform utilisation and client ROI



  





**Who Should Apply** 



* 0–2 years of experience in client\-facing roles — SaaS implementation, customer success, technology consulting, or enterprise onboarding
* Exposure to construction, infrastructure, real estate, or asset\-heavy industries is strongly preferred
* Demonstrated ability to engage independently with senior client stakeholders and navigate complex organisational environments
* Strong first\-principles thinking — you break problems into components, ask the right questions, and adapt when plans meet reality
* Excellent communication and documentation skills — your MOMs, SOPs, and training materials are clear, structured, and acted upon
* Data literacy and comfort with technology — advanced Excel, familiarity with dashboarding tools, and openness to learning SQL and Python
* High ownership and bias for action — you move fast, flag blockers early, and do not wait for instructions



**Ideal prior backgrounds include:** 



* Campus placements, internships, or early\-career stints in enterprise SaaS, management consulting, or technology services
* Operations, project coordination, or EIC support roles in construction, EPC, real estate, or field\-operations environments
* Customer\-facing roles in B2B product companies with structured onboarding or implementation components



  





**What This Role Is Not** 




 We want to be transparent about fit:
 


* This is not a remote or hybrid position. You will be deployed at client sites and RDash offices across India. Domestic travel is a core part of the role.
* This is not a passive support role. You are not logging tickets or forwarding requests — you are accountable for the success of enterprise implementations on the ground.
* This is not a pure training or coordination role. You will engage directly with CXO and VP\-level stakeholders and be expected to hold your own in consultative conversations.
* This requires maturity, independence, and comfort operating in ambiguity — particularly when deploying software inside organisations where digital maturity is being built from scratch.



  





**Skills \& Competencies** 




**Must\-Have** 



* Client\-facing presence and communication — ability to run structured discovery sessions, present confidently to department heads, and maintain professional relationships on\-prem
* Documentation capability — MOMs, SOPs, training schedules, audit reports, and adoption dashboards that are clear and immediately usable
* Data literacy — advanced Excel, ability to structure and interpret operational data, and comfort working with reporting tools
* Organisational rigour — managing parallel workstreams across multiple stakeholders without dropping threads
* Escalation discipline — knowing when and how to surface blockers to the EIC Lead and client leadership with the right context



**Strong Advantages** 



* SQL proficiency and ability to run basic analytical queries
* Familiarity with dashboarding tools such as Grafana, Metabase, or Power BI
* Exposure to workflow automation, AI agents, or no\-code/low\-code platforms
* Understanding of construction workflows: BOQ management, DPR, procurement cycles, vendor coordination, and site operations
* Experience with tools such as Jira, Figma, Whimsical, or Notion for process documentation and project mapping
* Working knowledge of business software ecosystems including accounting platforms (Tally), project management tools (Zoho Projects), and CRM systems — with an understanding of how these interact with a construction management platform in an enterprise environment
* Hands\-on experience configuring or managing integrations between enterprise tools — including field mapping, data transformation, and workflow handoffs across systems such as ERP, CRM, and communication platforms (e.g. Meta Business Suite, WhatsApp API)
* Ability to design and document end\-to\-end operational workflows — mapping process steps, decision nodes, roles, and system touchpoints with precision; experience translating client workflows into structured platform configurations is a strong plus



  





**Locations** 



* **India:** 
 Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune — In\-office \+ client site deployment. You will split time between RDash offices and enterprise client locations. Domestic travel is a core part of the role.



  





**Why RDash** 



* **Category\-defining product —** 
 AI\-powered construction management is an emerging category, and RDash is leading it in India and the Middle East
* **Enterprise client exposure from Day 1 —** 
 you will work inside organisations like Amazon, JSW, and Danube, not hypothetical case studies
* **Accelerated skill development —** 
 structured training in SQL, Python, data analytics, and AI agent deployment is built into your growth path
* **Direct mentorship —** 
 you will work closely with an experienced EIC Lead and have visibility into how enterprise SaaS companies are deployed at scale
* **Real problems, real impact —** 
 construction execution affects livelihoods, infrastructure, and national development; you are not optimising ad clicks



  





**How to Apply** 




 Qualified candidates are invited to submit their application to
 **prachi.verma@rdash.io**

title: Software Engineer
description:
What You Can Expect
   

  

 You’ll build and scale modern applications that solve real business problems and improve user experience. You’ll work across frontend, backend, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and AI\-powered workflows to deliver impactful solutions quickly. You’ll have opportunities to learn fast, take ownership early, and work with modern engineering practices used in high\-scale environments.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our team builds scalable platforms and internal products that support engineering and business operations. We move fast, collaborate closely, and encourage continuous learning and experimentation. We value engineers who are curious, adaptable, and excited to grow in the AI\-driven software engineering era.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Designing, developing, and maintaining frontend and backend applications.
* Building responsive UI components and reliable backend APIs for scalable applications.
* Collaborating with product managers, designers, and engineers to deliver features quickly and iteratively.

* Debugging production issues, improving application performance, and ensuring service reliability.
* Working with databases, cloud platforms, and containerized environments.
* Leveraging AI\-powered developer tools and modern workflows to improve productivity and accelerate delivery.

 What We’re Looking For

*

description:

**Position Summary**
**Software Engineer I** 
**(Frontend \+ Node.js)**
 Delo itte Digital has created a new model for a new age: the creative digital consultancy. We're transforming the digital journey in a way an agency or traditional consultancy alone cannot–now leaders across their entire organization can come to one place to have their ambitions brought to life. We combined the creative and digital capabilities of our studios and the broad reach of an advertising agency with the technical experience, deep business strategy, and relationships of one of the world's largest consultancy to create something that is so much more than the sum of its parts. At Deloitte Digital you will be working with amazingly creative and engineering minds, who craft beautiful and scalable solutions that inspire technical innovation, both within our company and to our esteemed clients as a whole. What unites our engineers is the pride they take for writing CSS for a CRM tool or creating cutting edge web components for a transactional banking site. Wide range of challenges will never let you have a dull moment in your life at Deloitte Digital.
   

  

 But it’s not all about work all the time, we are a bunch of fun\-loving folks. The team embarks upon trekking adventures, plays various sports. At Deloitte Digital, you always get to find time for your hobbies. Various initiatives like collective disconnect (Taking off from work during the week of Christmas), Flexi timing enables you to find that little time for you to play with your kitten or read that Sherlock Holmes book you always wanted to.
   

  

 Leaders at Deloitte Digital love technology! Megathon – our annual event of solving problems – 2\-day event where we challenge the status quo by providing solution to problems.
   

  

 You have an innovative solution and would like to showcase it? We have a platform for that as well. Show and tell events are informal and serves as an opportunity for everyone to promote their ideas. Learning never stops at Deloitte digital, to accentuate this idea, our open houses event serves a great purpose. So, if you ever wanted to learn about playing that Guitar, learn about creating beautiful prototypes using Sketch just walk into these events, which happen almost every month.
   

  

 Community is very important to Deloitte. We have been showing our gratitude through our Global initiative – Impact Day \- for last 20 years. It’s a one\-day event where we go back to community to serve them.
   

  

 To understand us better, visit our Instagram page. Get a peep into how our leaders think, here .
   

  

**Work You’ll Do:**
 We are seeking a highly skilled Full Stack Developer with a strong background in both frontend and backend development using Node.js. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in building robust, scalable applications and a deep understanding of modern web technologies.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Develop, test, and maintain high\-quality web applications using modern frontend frameworks and Node.js.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features.
* Optimize applications for maximum speed and scalability.
* Implement and ensure best practices in frontend and backend development.
* Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.
* Troubleshoot and debug issues across the stack.
* Stay up\-to\-date with emerging trends and technologies in software development.
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to the improvement of the overall codebase


**Requirements:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 3\-6 years of experience in full stack development.
* Proficiency in JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and modern frontend frameworks (such as React, Angular, or Vue.js).
* Extensive experience with Node.js and frameworks like Express.js.
* Strong understanding of RESTful APIs and WebSocket protocols.
* Familiarity with database technologies such as MongoDB, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.
* Experience with version control systems, preferably Git.
* Knowledge of cloud services (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud).
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Strong communication and teamwork abilities.


**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
* Familiarity with TypeScript.
* Understanding of containerization technologies like Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience in Agile/Scrum methodologies.

 At Deloitte, we’ve invested a great deal to create a rich environment in which our professionals can grow. We provide our professionals with a variety of learning and networking opportunities, some of which are:
   

  

* Intensive trainings on latest technologies from eminent external trainers.
* Internal trainings and workshops.
* Subscriptions to prominent online training platforms, such as Lynda.
* Hackathons and tech challenges to exercise your front\-end skills.
* Freedom to adopt and use the latest technologies in your live projects.
* Travel opportunity (wherever possible) to work at the client’s location or at our global offices.


 Apart from the above, you will have access to DU: The Leadership Center in India, our state\-of\-the\-art, world\-class learning Center in the Hyderabad offices is an extension of the DU in Westlake, Texas, and represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to our people’s growth and development.  Our positive and supportive culture encourages our people to do their best every day.  Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. title: Software Engineer III, General Software Development, Core
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience with software programming in C\+\+, Java, Python or Go.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or a related technical field.
* 2 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
* Experience designing, implementing, and analyzing advanced algorithms
* Experience in developing accessible technologies.
* Familiarity with the EDA tooling ecosystem that underpins chip design or many of the algorithmic techniques used in such tools.


**About The Job**
 Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward.
   

  

 HighTide is adding capabilities to open source tooling that performs the tasks. YouTube’s Video Coding Unit (VCU) has been using HighTide to perform frequent measurement of hardware improvements.
   

  

 The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Write product or system development code.
* Lead design reviews with peers and stakeholders to select among available technologies.
* Review code developed by other developers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).
* Contribute to existing documentation or educational content and adapt content based on product/program updates and user feedback.
* Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on hardware, network, or service operations and quality.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .
